plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope

**Agent 权限边界** —— 查 agent 的工具/文件/网络权限有没有声明、是不是过宽。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 MCP 配置长这样：

```json
"filesystem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/"] },
"everything": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-everything"], "allowedTools": ["*"] }
```

**看起来是「配置齐全」，实际上：**

```
① 文件访问路径是 /       → agent 能读写你所有文件（含 ~/.ssh、~/.aws）
② allowedTools: ["*"]    → agent 能调用所有工具（读文件、执行命令、发请求）
③ allowedDomains: "*"    → 被注入后能把数据发到任意地址
```

**Agent 的权限就是它的爆炸半径。** 一旦被提示注入控制，
它能做的事 = **你给它的全部权限**。

OWASP 把这归为 **LLM06 Excessive Agency**。

## 关键词
**关键词**：Agent 权限 · 工具权限 · 权限边界 · 最小权限 · MCP 权限 · 沙箱 · 白名单 · 爆炸半径
**Keywords**: agent scope · tool permissions · least privilege · MCP security · excessive agency · sandbox

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 工具权限用通配符 `*` | 最小权限（NIST SP 800-53 AC-6）|
| 🔴 高 | 文件访问是 `/` / `~` / 整个用户目录 | MCP 文档 · 目录限制建议 |
| 🟡 中 | 网络访问无限制 | OWASP **LLM06 Excessive Agency** |
| 🟡 中 | 配置里**找不到任何权限声明** | 最小权限 · 权限应显式声明 |

## 「没有声明」为什么危险

**没有声明通常等于默认全开** —— 而用户看到的只是一个「很干净」的配置文件，
不会意识到 agent 能做所有事。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope
```

![dsh-agent-scope 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/report.png)

![dsh-agent-scope 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/demo.png)

![dsh-agent-scope 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-agent-scope --demo
dsh-agent-scope --list-rules
dsh-agent-scope --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **只审配置，不审 agent 实现** —— agent 代码里怎么用这些权限，本工具看不到。
- **不判断「给得够不够」** —— 只查「有没有声明、有没有明显过宽」。
  权限偏大但没用通配符的情况需要人工评审。
- **配置位置各客户端不同** —— 按常见路径找（mcp.json / .mcp.json / settings.json / claude_desktop_config.json）。
- **沙箱是否真生效** 需要运行时验证，不在范围内。
- 与 [dsh-mcp-audit](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) 分工：
  那个查 MCP **服务来源**（未锁版本/明文端点），这个查 MCP **权限边界**。
- 与 [dsh-least-privilege](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) 分工：
  那个查**容器/云/Web** 权限，这个查 **agent** 权限。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 38 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理**（6）｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据**（5）｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建**（5）｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急**（3）｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

**行业专项**（4）｜ [医疗行业专项](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-industry-medical) · [教育行业专项](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-industry-education) · [金融行业专项](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-industry-finance) · [地方数据条例](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-local-regulation)

**编排与交付**（3）｜ [一键体检](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-guard-suite) · [改前改后复核](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-fix-verify) · [合规可交付文档](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-compliance-doc)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。

plugins.description: Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins from GitHub topic:dsh-plugin — trust score, official peer compatibility, one-click install via the official installer
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Plugin Scout

[English](README.md) | [中文](docs/zh.md)

[![ci](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml) · MIT

Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins published under the GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, from inside DSH. Plugins are grouped by purpose, ranked by trust score, and checked against the official peer-compatibility rule. Supports DSH **0.2.x** (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`); tested on desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.

> The in-app UI is currently Chinese only. The plugin's title and description in the official Plugins page are localized (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`).

## Install

Open the official **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**, and enter one of:

| Spec | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-plugin-scout` | Recommended. Prebuilt npm package with provenance; no install scripts, no build approval needed |
| Absolute path of a prebuilt `dsh-plugin-scout-<version>.tgz`, if supplied with a release | Bypasses the npm registry; the current tag workflow creates release notes only and does not attach a tarball |

From the CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-scout`. Enable it on the Plugins page, then open **Plugins → Scout**. The tab is labeled **Scout** in both languages; no sidebar entry is added. The official **Discover** tab is unchanged.

Do not install from `github:fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout`: a git install fetches source without `lib/`, and this repository deliberately ships no `prepare` script.

## Native Discover index

Add this URL in the official **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** dialog:

```text
https://fegnze.github.io/dsh-plugin-scout/index.json
```

This is a format-1 catalog, not an embedded Scout page. You do not need to install Scout to browse it. GitHub Actions rebuilds it daily at 03:23 UTC and on generator changes, then deploys only after the official DSH validator accepts the document. Failed generation leaves the previous deployment intact.

The public catalog contains deduplicated npm bundles compatible with the target DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with a matching repository, no install hooks, and advertised provenance. Archived, risky, version-drifted, stale or incomplete entries are excluded. Forks retain a source label. Provenance presence is not cryptographic verification or a security guarantee. Each entry pins the npm version and uses npm's real release time; the official installer remains the final authority. The target runtime is a publishing policy, not a compatibility claim for every DSH release.

Generate from public GitHub/npm data with `GH_TOKEN=<read-only-token> node scripts/generate-market.mjs`. `MARKET_OUTPUT`, `SCOUT_CACHE`, and `DSH_TARGET` override the output, disposable crawl cache, and target runtime. No local profile or user cache is published. The generated `site/index.json` and crawl cache are ignored by Git; CI uploads only the public catalog as the Pages artifact. Adding the source remains your explicit action; Scout does not alter configured index sources.

## One-click install, through the official installer

The **Install** button in the details drawer takes the same path as the official **Add plugin**: `inspect` first, then `installBundle(spec, {enabled: false, requestId, registry})`. Installed plugins start **disabled**; **Enable** is a separate click (`setBundleEnabled`).

- Plugins with install hooks, or whose DSH peers do not cover the running version, need a second click to install.
- When the official installer blocks dependency build scripts (`pendingBuilds`), they are listed by name; a double click on **Allow and reinstall** retries with `approvedBuilds`.
- **Cancel install** calls `cancelInstall` with the same `requestId`; a lost reply is recovered with `waitForInstall`. On failure the official installer restores `package.json` and the lockfile.
- **Uninstalling and version exemptions stay on the official Plugins page.** Scout never calls `removeBundle`; the tests fail if it does. Without the official `pluginManager`, the Install button is hidden and the drawer falls back to "copy pinned spec + open the Plugins page".

## Data sources (first-party only)

| Source | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub GraphQL `search(topic:dsh-plugin)` | Repository metadata, root `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` text (never evaluated) |
| `registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest` | The manifest that would actually be installed: peers, install hooks, `repository`, provenance |
| Official `pluginManager.listBundles` / `inspect` | Installed state; the official pre-install check (resolves only, runs no code) |
| Official `pluginManager.installBundle` / `waitForInstall` / `cancelInstall` / `setBundleEnabled` | One-click install (disabled by default), cancel, separate enable; progress from `plugin-manager/install-state` and `install-log` events |

No third-party marketplace or aggregator is used. Topic searches explicitly use `fork:true` to include both original repositories and forks; forks retain their source notice and undergo the same checks. After upgrading from 0.1.5 or earlier, use **Rebuild full index** once to discover older forks omitted by the previous search scope.

**Crawling, measured (2026-10):** the topic holds about 19,000 repositories, 12,700 of them created in August, many of them same-name copies. GitHub search returns at most 1,000 results per query, so Scout bisects time windows adaptively (≤900 results per window, 60 s minimum window). Pages are 50 items: 100-item pages return 502 in dense windows, so on 502 the page size steps down to 25, then 10, resuming from the same cursor. Later runs crawl incrementally by `pushed`.

**Refresh is streaming and pays only for what changed:**
- **Newest first.** Windows are seeded geometrically (last 6 h / 1 d / 3 d / 1 w / 1 mo / 3 mo / older) and paged from the newest. Window counting and paging overlap (3 workers).
- **Publish while crawling.** Each page is merged into the record set immediately and published every 1.5 s; the UI reloads the list when `status.rev` changes. The previous index stays usable throughout. A checkpoint is written every 30 s.
- **Pay for change.** With an existing index, a light query fetches metadata only (100 per page, no blobs). Repositories whose `pushedAt` is unchanged keep their facts and only refresh stars and similar metadata; changed ones fetch `package.json` and the patch by node id in batches of 50.
- **npm in parallel.** npm lookups run alongside the GitHub crawl (8 workers), only for repositories with new pushes, missing entries, or entries older than one day. Entries older than one day are refreshed oldest first, at most 800 per run, even when the repository was not seen in that incremental crawl.
- **Canonical source recovery.** A refresh also follows same-name npm packages' GitHub `repository` links with bounded, exact read-only queries. A source is added only when GitHub's actual root manifest declares the same package name; missing topics never justify treating an unrelated namesake as the publisher. Failed lookups do not fabricate source facts.
- **Activation does not wait for the index.** The ~30 MB index loads in the background; the UI first sees `loaded: false` and polls.

Measured on 2026-10-14 over a real network:

| Scenario | First results | Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Incremental, 1,082 repos pushed | 4.5 s | 38 s | 125 refetched blobs, 963 metadata-only, 70 npm lookups |
| Cold full crawl | 6.7 s | — | ~1,000 plugins browsable within 60 s; the rest fill in the background |

## Checks and trust score

| Check | Rule | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V1 | Root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` (otherwise not a plugin) | 20 |
| V2 | Official peer rule: only `@deepseek-ai/dsh` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, {includePrerelease})`, `workspace:*` means the running version. Inside the App, Scout calls `dsh-app-boot.evaluatePluginCompatibility` directly | covered 30 · no peers 10 · not covered 5 |
| V3 | Install hooks: preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare | none +15 · present −15 |
| V4 | Source chain: the same-name npm package's `repositor

plugins.description: JVM production-report doctor for DeepSeek Harness: jstack/cmd thread dumps, GC logs, Maven/Gradle dependency conflicts, stack traces and Spring config diffs parsed into structured diagnoses.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-jvm-doctor

**离线、确定性的 JVM 生产报告诊断器** — 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，向模型注册 5 个工具：粘贴线程 dump / GC 日志 / 依赖树 / 异常栈 / Spring 配置文本，换回结构化诊断与诚实的解析覆盖率回执。

[![CI](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-jvm-doctor/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-jvm-doctor/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
MIT License · DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 验证通过 · Node ≥ 20.10（运行）/ ≥ 22.6（测试）

> **永不接触运行中的进程** · 无 `jcmd` / `jstack` / `jmap` / `jstat` / attach / JMX · 无网络 · 无文件读取 · 无时钟、无随机 · 每次调用都带字节回执

---

## 快速开始

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-jvm-doctor)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-jvm-doctor)
![tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-5-blue) ![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-47%20passing-brightgreen) ![network](https://img.shields.io/badge/network-none-informational) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jvm-doctor
```

装完**重启应用**。想一次装齐四个插件（含 [deterministic-tools](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-deterministic-tools) / [py-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-py-doctor) / [win-native](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-win-native)）用 [`dsh-toolbox-bundle`](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-toolbox-bundle)；**别和单独安装混用**。

**家族总览**：[zicode.com/software](https://zicode.com/software/) 是四个插件、合装包与桌面软件的统一入口。

**15 秒看效果** —— 把异常栈贴进去，模型调用 `java_stack_trace`，拿回（实测输出）：

```
root_cause: java.lang.IllegalStateException: inner
primary:    java.lang.RuntimeException: boom
frames:     com.acme.Main.main(Main.java:7)      coverage: 100% (3/3, parser 1)
```

线程 dump 同理：`java_thread_dump` 给出 **Java 级死锁环**（`waiting_for` / `holding` 链），而不是让你在 500 个线程里自己找。

**为什么不让模型自己写 pwsh？** 死锁环、GC 停顿 p50/p90/p99、依赖冲突消解、`... N more` 折叠还原——写成脚本都是几十行，每次还得重新写对；工具是固定实现 + 47 个测试，并且**只出结构化事实、不做因果推断**。

相邻插件：[dsh-deterministic-tools](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-deterministic-tools) · [dsh-py-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-py-doctor) · [dsh-win-native](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-win-native) · [dsh-toolbox-bundle](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-toolbox-bundle)

---

## 为什么需要它

JVM 生产排查的证据几乎全部长这样：一段 `jstack` 输出、一坨 `-Xlog:gc` 日志、一棵 `dependency:tree`、一条 `Caused by:` 链、一份 `application.yml`。这些文本**运维手里已经有了**，但模型拿到之后只能：

1. **自己起进程去采** —— 生产环境通常不允许：容器里没有 `jcmd`、权限与审计不让 attach、事故期间更不该再给 JVM 加负担；
2. **或者肉眼心算** —— 95 行 jstack 里哪几个线程互相持有锁、`Found 1 deadlock` 之外还有没有第二个环、`omitted for conflict with` 到底谁赢了，全靠猜，而且不可复现。

`dsh-jvm-doctor` 只做一件事：**把已到手的文本变成结构化诊断**。它刻意不做采集 —— 没有 `jcmd`、没有 `jstack`、没有 attach、没有 JMX、没有网络、没有文件系统读取。每个工具都是纯函数：同样的输入永远给同样的输出。

顺带解决一个更隐蔽的问题：**「解析失败」和「没有异常」长得一模一样**。所有工具都返回 `unknown_lines` / `unknown_samples` / `coverage` / `confidence`，并且把预算导致的截断逐条报数，所以「没发现问题」和「没看懂输入」永远不会被混为一谈。

## 设计契约：每个结果都是回执

规范返回值固定为：

```json
{
  "result": { "…工具自己的载荷…": true },
  "meta": {
    "bytesIn": 5396,
    "bytesOut": 7716,
    "truncated": false,
    "notes": []
  }
}
```

模型看到的就是 `result`（对象给格式化 JSON），**只有**当发生截断或需要解释时才追加页脚：

```
[bounded] input=2307B output=5615B
[note] 7 frame(s) hidden behind `... N more` could not be resolved because the enclosing trace was truncated or absent
```

干净的调用不花额外 token；有问题的调用一定说清楚。

### 边界行为（五种，绝不混淆）

| 情况 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 输入超 `maxInputBytes` | **抛错拒绝**：报出实际字节、上限，并明确「没有任何截断或部分处理」 |
| 渲染文本超 `maxOutputBytes` | **按 code point 边界截断** + `truncated: true` + note（`meta.bytesOut` 仍报真实载荷大小） |
| 结构化列表超预算（线程数 / GC cause 数 / 冲突数 / 每条冲突的边数 / 异常数 / 每异常的帧数 / 差异条数） | **截断并逐条报数**：`threads_omitted`、`causes_omitted`、`conflicts_omitted`、`edges_omitted`、`exceptions_omitted`、`frames_omitted`、`changes_omitted` |
| 不认识的语法 | **绝不静默丢弃**：计入 `unknown_lines`，`unknown_samples` 里给出原文，并按覆盖率下调 `confidence` |
| 无法给出结论 | 返回诚实标记（`confidence`、`findings`、`errors[]`），而不是编一个诊断 |

## 安装

npm（推荐）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jvm-doctor
```

预构建 tarball（与 npm 上是同一份产物，无需构建步骤，也避开 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 授权）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ax2/dsh-jvm-doctor/releases/latest/download/dsh-jvm-doctor.tgz
```

要固定版本就把 `latest/download/dsh-jvm-doctor.tgz` 换成 `download/v<version>/dsh-jvm-doctor-<version>.tgz`。

本地开发：不安装，直接挂载构建产物。

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm build
dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.local-overlay.yml --dump-config   # 先验证层合成
dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.local-overlay.yml                 # 再启动
```

## 配置

`apply(ctx, config)` 接受以下配置（全部可选，含默认值）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `maxInputBytes` | `2097152` | 单份粘贴文本的硬上限（UTF-8 字节），超过即拒绝 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `262144` | 渲染文本的软上限，超过即按 code point 截断并标记 |
| `maxThreads` | `200` | `java_thread_dump` 序列化的线程条目上限 |
| `maxStatusLines` | `40` | `java_thread_dump` 汇总的状态行上限 |
| `maxContention` | `20` | `java_thread_dump` 报告的锁竞争队列上限 |
| `maxGcEvents` | `500` | `java_gc_log` 保留的 GC cause 种类上限 |
| `maxPauseSamples` | `5000` | 计算百分位所用的停顿样本上限 |
| `maxConflicts` | `100` | `java_dependency_conflicts` 报告的冲突 artifact 上限 |
| `maxEdgesPerConflict` | `20` | 每条冲突保留的边上限 |
| `maxExceptions` | `25` | `java_stack_trace` 保留的异常链条目上限 |
| `maxFramesPerException` | `60` | 每个异常保留的帧上限 |
| `maxChanges` | `500` | `spring_config_diff` 报告的差异条数上限 |
| `maxKeys` | `5000` | 每份配置文档展平后的键上限 |
| `sampleLimit` | `5` | `unknown_samples` 保留的原文行数上限 |
| `toolPrefix` | `''` | 工具名前缀，例如 `jvm` → `jvm__java_thread_dump` |
| `only` | `[]` | 只注册指定工具（空 = 全部） |

非法值（`0`、负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`）静默回落到默认值，并向下取整 —— 一个坏配置无法把预算关掉。

## 工具清单（5 个）

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `java_thread_dump` | 解析 `jstack` / `jcmd <pid> Thread.print`：线程普查、归一化与原文状态直方图、daemon 数、每线程 top 帧与锁、**Java 级死锁环（含 waiting_for/holding 链）**、`Object.wait`/park 计数、锁竞争队列 |
| `java_gc_log` | 解析 JEP 158 统一日志与 JDK 9 之前的旧式 GC 行：事件/停顿计数、总/均/最大停顿、p50/p90/p99 百分位、Young/Full 拆分、堆前后区间、cause 直方图、promotion failure，并在有时间戳时估算分配速率 |
| `java_dependency_conflicts` | 解析 Maven `dependency:tree -Dverbose` 与 Gradle `dependencies` / `dependencyInsight`：同一 artifact 的多版本、`omitted for conflict with X`、`omitted for duplicate`、每条边所在深度、逐 artifact 结论摘要 |
| `java_stack_trace` | 解析异常链：类型与消息、`class.method(file:line)` 帧、`Caused by:` 链、`Suppressed:` 块、**`... N more` 折叠按外层 trace 还原**、最深的业务帧、最多 6 条可能原因提示 |
| `spring_config_diff` | 把两份 `application.yml` / `.properties` 展平成点号键后逐键对比（add / remove / change）；**敏感值在进入载荷之前就替换为 `***`** |

### `java_thread_dump` — 死锁环与竞争队列

输入（节选；真实示例是完整 `jstack -l`）：

```
Full thread dump OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (21.0.4+7-LTS-103 mixed mode, sharing):

"deadlock-A" #40 ... nid=0x2b00 waiting for monitor entry
   java.lang.Thread.State: BLOCKED (on object monitor)
	at com.acme.order.Inventory.reserve(Inventory.java:61)
	- waiting to lock <0x0000000712d00020> (a com.acme.order.Inventory)
	- locked <0x0000000712c00010> (a com.acme.order.OrderDao)
...
Found one Java-level deadlock:
"deadlock-A":
  waiting to lock monitor 0x... (object 0x0000000712d00020, a com.acme.order.Inventory),
  which is held by "deadlock-B"
"Thead-B": ... which is held by "deadlock-A"
Found 1 deadlock.
```

输出（节选，`…` 表示省略）：

```json
{
  "source": "jstack",
  "jvm_version": "OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM",
  "captured_at": "2026-01-02 03:04:05",
  "thread_count": 9,
  "daemon_threads": 2,
  "state_histogram": { "RUNNABLE": 1, "WAITING": 1, "BLOCKED": 5, "TIMED_WAITING": 2 },
  "raw_state_histogram": {
    "RUNNABLE": 1, "WAITING (parking)": 1, "BLOCKED (on object monitor)": 5,
    "TIMED_WAITING (sleeping)": 1, "TIMED_WAITING (on object monitor)": 1
  },
  "deadlock_marker": true,
  "reported_deadlock_count": 1,
  "deadlock_cycles": [{
    "threads": ["deadlock-A", "deadlock-B"],
    "locks": ["0x0000000712d00020", "0x0000000712c00010"],
    "chain": [
      { "thread": "deadlock-A", "waiting_for": "0x0000000712d00020", "holding": "0x0000000712c00010" },
      { "thread": "deadlock-B", "waiting_for": "0x0000000712c00010", "holding": "0x0000000712d00020" }
    ]
  }],
  "lock_contention_candidates": [{
    "method": "com.acme.order.OrderDao.save",
    "thread_count": 4,
    "threads": ["worker-1", "worker-2", "worker-3", "deadlock-B"],
    "states": ["BLOCKED"]
  }],
  "total_lines": 95, "parsed_lines": 95, "unknown_lines": 0,
  "coverage": 1, "confidence": "high"
}
```

`state_histogram` 是归一化枚举（`BLOCKED`），`raw_state_histogram` 保留 JVM 原话（`BLOCKED (on object monitor)`）—— 归一化便于统计，原文便于核对，两者都不丢。

**明确拒绝**：文本超 `maxInputBytes` 抛错；只认得 dump 语法的行，任何其它行都进 `unknown_lines` 并降 `confidence`，不会当成「线程正常」。

# dsh-lit-search-mcp

MCP server for academic literature search, citation formatting (GB/T 7714 / APA) and BibTeX generation — Crossref + OpenAlex + Semantic Scholar, merged and deduplicated, **no API key needed**.

Thin MCP wrapper over [dsh-lit-search](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lit-search) (also available as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, a CLI, and a SKILL.md).

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `lit_search` | Keyword search merged across Crossref / OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar, deduplicated by DOI, with citation counts. Options: `limit`, `year_from`, `year_to`, `sort` (citations/date/relevance). |
| `lit_cite` | Format a citation for a DOI: `gbt7714` (default, Chinese standard), `gbt7714-numeric`, `apa`, `bibtex`. |
| `lit_bib` | Batch BibTeX entries for a list of DOIs (reports which DOIs failed). |
| `lit_related` | Related works for a DOI via OpenAlex. |

## Install

Claude Code:

```bash
claude mcp add lit-search -- npx -y dsh-lit-search-mcp
```

Any MCP host (Cursor, ChatGPT, ...):

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "lit-search": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "dsh-lit-search-mcp"] } } }
```

Requires Node.js ≥ 20. Listed on the official MCP Registry as `io.github.Flan246/dsh-lit-search`.

线**（带十字光标与右侧价格标签），**顶部指标区随之切换**：选中时显示该根的日期/开高低收/涨跌/量/振幅，不选中则显示当日行情；双击图表或点空白处取消钉住；**钉住后可用 ← / → 逐根切换**（到数据边界不越界，切出可视窗口时图表自动跟随，输入框内不抢按键） | | 悬浮窗·设置 | 指数栏显隐/样式/位置、刷新间隔（3~60s）、涨跌配色、**测试数据源**、**🔔 预警**（二级页）、恢复默认；**配置损坏告警常驻条**（见「配置安全」） | | 设置 · 预警（二级页） | 规则管理（8 种条件：现价上/下穿、突破/跌破成本、涨幅/跌幅达标、接近涨跌停、涨速达标；**成本类自动取持仓成本价**）+ 总开关 + 桌面通知开关。规则**按股票代码分组抽屉**——同一只票的多条规则收在一组，组头常驻显示「名称 + 代码 + 条数 + 已触发数」并带 `▸/▾` 展开箭头，手风琴单开（展开一组自动收起另一组）；新加规则自动展开对应组，不会藏进收起态；**超 10 组内部滚动**（按组计数，不是按规则条数）。**规则没有「停用」一说：存在即评估，删除就是停用**（列表里有它就一定会响，不会出现"看得见却永远不响"的规则）。**评估在 Host 独立循环**——关掉页面也会照常评估。自选/持仓行右键「🔔 设为预警」可预填现价/成本价快速建规则。设计依据与验收见 [docs/alerts-plan.md](docs/alerts-plan.md) | | 预警弹窗 | 触发时在**对话区顶部居中**弹出（**与悬浮窗开关无关**：关着悬浮窗照样弹）。**同一时间最多 3 条**，再多则叠加到最早那条并显示 `+N`；**10 秒自动消失**，也可点 `✕` / `Escape` / 「全部关闭（N）」手动关。倒计时**只在页面可见时走**（隐藏时冻结），避免你不在时悄悄过期。另外不弹 toast（弹窗已足够醒目）、**不记录触发历史** | ### 预警行为 - **每交易日每规则只提示一次**：触发过就不再重复，即使价格回落再涨回；次日（按**行情时间戳的市场本地日**判定，美股不会在北京时间 00:00 被误重置）重新生效。 - **休市/节假日不评估**：按 code 逐个判断交易时段，且要求「报价日 == 该市场本地当日」——休市时报价停在上一个交易日，条件可能恒真，必须跳过，否则每逢节假日误报一次。 - **缺数据宁可不报**：无时间戳、成本缺失（持仓已清仓）、港美股用「接近涨跌停」等情形一律跳过。 - **零成本休眠**：没有任何规则 / 总开关关闭 / 全市场休市 → 评估循环退避，**一次上游请求都不打**。 ## 配置 配置以 **Host 文件为准**（`~/.dsh/dsh-stock-leek/config.json`），浏览器 `localStorage` 仅作首屏缓存。写入前自动备份 `.bak`；解析失败时保留 `.corrupt` 现场并回退备份，**不会静默吞掉持仓**；多标签页通过 `BroadcastChannel` 同步并用版本号检测冲突。 预警的规则状态（判断「今日是否已提示过」）单独落盘 `config.json.alerts`（**与配置分文件**：评估循环高频读写，不该每次都重写配置、搅动 `__rev` 乐观锁；路径派生自配置路径，因此测试的 pid 隔离自动继承）。该文件**只存状态、不存触发历史**——历史已按要求去掉，`states` 必须保留，否则 Host 重启后会重复播报。 字段清单、旧路径搬迁、持仓与预警规则结构、代码归一化规则 → **[docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md)** ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) | 全局架构、目录职责、SSE 行情通道、`client.js` 为何无法 import 共享模块、盈亏口径 | | [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md) | 配置字段表、持仓与预警规则结构、配置安全机制、代码归一化 | | [docs/development.md](docs/development.md) | 跑测试、套件分工、写测试的硬规矩、加配置字段的检查清单 | | [docs/alerts-plan.md](docs/alerts-plan.md) | 预警功能设计与决策依据：为何评估必须在 Host、穿越状态机与滞回、交易日判据、账本落盘、通知降级、验收对照 | ## 架构 ``` 浏览器（client.js） ├─ conversation.composer.dock → 左下角指数栏（IndexBar） ├─ shell.overlay → 悬浮窗（大盘/自选/持仓/设置 + 预警二级页/详情） ├─ 共享 store：配置 + 行情快照 + SSE/轮询双通道（页面隐藏自动暂停） ├─ 预警流 /alert-stream：**隐藏时保持连接**（触发稀疏、零上游请求） └─ 自绘 SVG 分时 / K线 / 盈亏曲线（零 CDN 依赖） │ fetch 同源 /dsh-stock-leek/* ▼ Host（index.js，cordis 插件，依赖 webServer） ├─ /config GET/POST 读写配置（含首屏行情快照、版本号、损坏告警） ├─ /stream SSE 行情推送（多标签页共用一次拉取） ├─ 预警评估循环：与订阅者无关，无规则/休市自动休眠 ├─ /alerts GET 规则状态（客户端重连后对账；不返回触发历史） ├─ /alert-stream SSE 预警推送（独立订阅集合，不参与行情广播开关） ├─ /quotes 批量实时行情（qt.gtimg.cn，GBK，1.5s TTL + 单飞去重） ├─ /minute 分时 /kline 日/周/月K(前复权) /search 全市场搜索 └─ /probe 数据源连通性自检 ▼ ~/.dsh/dsh-stock-leek/config.json ← 自选/持仓/指数栏/预警规则持久化（换浏览器不丢） ~/.dsh/dsh-stock-leek/config.json.alerts ← 预警规则状态（今日是否已提示；只存 states） lib/shared.js（纯函数，Host 与测试共用） 格式化（价格/百分比/金额/成交量/时间/代码）+ 盈亏口径（todayPnl 等） ``` ## 目录 ``` dsh-stock-leek/ ├── index.js # Host：webServer 路由 + 腾讯行情解析 + 配置持久化 + SSE 推送 ├── client.js # Client：__ModuleLoader__，左下角指数栏 + 悬浮窗 ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle patch（插入 host 插件行） ├── package.json # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明 ├── LICENSE # MIT 协议正文 ├── lib/ # 可复用代码 │ └── shared.js # 纯函数：格式化 + 盈亏口径（Host/测试共用） ├── docs/ # 详细文档 │ ├── architecture.md │ ├── configuration.md │ ├── development.md │ └── alerts-plan.md # 预警功能设计与决策依据 ├── test/ # 集成测试（零外部依赖，直接跑） │ ├── config-guard.mjs # 测试配置路径隔离守卫（共用） │ ├── plugin-contract.mjs # 插件装载契约（package.json ↔ patch ↔ bundle id） │ ├── config-isolation.mjs# 守卫自身自检（导入顺序写错会当场抛错） │ ├── shared-drift.mjs # shared.js ↔ client.js 纯函数对拍 │ ├── config-path.mjs # 默认配置路径 + 旧路径搬迁（子进程 + 假 HOME） │ ├── test-routes.mjs # Host 路由层 │ ├── security.mjs # 安全回归：URL 注入 / 配置净化 / SSE 事件注入 │ ├── alert-loop-ref.mjs # 预警循环定时器自触发（独立子进程） │ └── e2e-render.mjs # Client 渲染层（mini-React + 真实路由） └── README.md ``` > `index.js` 与 `client.js` 刻意留在根目录：`package.json` 的 `exports` 与 `dsh.client` 声明按路径引用它们，DSH 打包依赖这个约定。 > > `lib/shared.js` 在 `client.js` 里有一份内联副本——平台限制导致 client 侧无法 import 共享模块，由 `test/shared-drift.mjs` 对拍防漂移，详见 [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)。 ## 测试 ```bash npm test # 八个套件全跑 node test/plugin-contract.mjs # 插件装载契约（package.json ↔ patch ↔ bundle id） node test/shared-drift.mjs # 纯函数一致性 + 关键函数性质对拍 node test/config-isolation.mjs# 配置路径隔离守卫自检 node test/config-path.mjs # 配置路径与旧路径搬迁 node test/test-routes.mjs # 路由层（备份/损坏/冲突/pnlCurve/SSE/预警清洗与状态机/休眠门控） node test/security.mjs # 安全层（URL 注入 / 配置净化 / SSE 注入） node test/alert-loop-ref.mjs # 预警循环定时器自触发（独立子进程，防 unref 回归）

plugins.description: DSH Web 会话整理插件：标签分类 · 归档 / 恢复 · 已归档浏览（DeepSeek Harness session organizer plugin）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-organizer

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 端**会话整理**插件：标签分类 · 归档 / 恢复 · 已归档浏览。
> Organize your DSH Web sessions: tag-based grouping, archive & restore, and an archived-session browser.

[![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://beancookie.github.io/awesome-dsh-plugin/badge.svg)](https://beancookie.github.io/awesome-dsh-plugin)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workspace-organizer.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-organizer)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH 自带的工作区视图只能按「目录」分组、组内只能排序，会话一多就堆在一起。
本插件为会话区补上一层**自定义分类维度**和**归档管理面板**，并且归档状态与 DSH 原生的
归档体系完全同源——操作后侧边栏会实时联动，没有 hack。

## 功能

- **悬浮按钮**：菱形图标，自动吸附在侧边栏底部「设置」区旁边（侧边栏伸缩 / 窗口变化自动跟随）。
- **整理面板**：
  - 按**标签**分组展示全部会话，未分类会话单列一组；
  - 底部独立「已归档」区，集中查看历史归档；
  - 顶部筛选 chips：`全部` / `未分类` / `已归档` / 各标签。
- **每个会话行**：
  - `标签`：增删标签，每会话最多 8 个，可用按钮一键复用已有标签；
  - `归档`：立即从原生侧边栏列表隐藏（**不删除数据**）；
  - `恢复`：把已归档会话一键放回侧边栏原位置。
- **实时联动**：归档 / 恢复直接走 DSH 内置的 `workspaceRegistry`，原生侧边栏同步更新。
- **主题自适应**：面板与图标使用 DSH 主题变量（`--dsw-*`），明 / 暗主题下都协调。

## 安装

### 方式一：npm（已发布后最省事）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workspace-organizer
```

### 方式二：直接从 GitHub 安装（无需等待 npm 发布）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Wang993/DSH_OrganizeFilesInTheSameWorkspace
```

### 方式三：本地 clone + link（开发用）

```powershell
git clone git@github.com:Wang993/DSH_OrganizeFilesInTheSameWorkspace.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<克隆下来的目录绝对路径>
```

### 方式四：手动编辑 profile

编辑 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`：

```json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-workspace-organizer"] } },
  "dependencies": { "dsh-workspace-organizer": "link:./dsh-workspace-organizer" }
}
```

把插件目录放到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/dsh-workspace-organizer`，然后在该目录执行 `pnpm install`。

四种方式安装后都需要**重启 `dsh web`** 并刷新页面，即可看到菱形按钮。

## 使用

1. 点击侧边栏设置区右侧的**菱形按钮**打开「会话整理」面板。
2. 点会话行的「标签」给它分类，再点顶部标签 chip 筛选。
3. 点「归档」把不用的会话收起来；在「🗄 已归档」区点「恢复」可随时放回。
4. 面板每 5 秒自动刷新（正在输入标签时不会打断）；也可以点「刷新」手动更新。

数据位置：标签存于 `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-organizer-tags.json`（纯 JSON，可备份、可手工编辑、可纳入版本管理）。

## 实现原理

| 部分 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 宿主插件 `lib/index.js` | 注入 `webServer` / `workspaceRegistry` / `sessionQuery`，注册 `/dsh-organizer/*` 路由，并用 `ctx.webServer.tapIndex()` 向页面注入客户端脚本 |
| 客户端 `lib/organizer.js` | 纯 DOM（无框架、无构建），负责按钮吸附、面板渲染、交互 |
| 会话列表 | `ctx.sessionQuery.listSessions()` 取全部会话，`readTitleSnapshots()` 折叠日志标题 |
| 归档 | `ctx.workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id)`（官方接口） |
| 恢复 | 读写内置 `archivedSessionIds` 状态集（官方未暴露反归档 RPC） |
| 按钮吸附 | 读取侧边栏设置区元素的屏幕位置，`MutationObserver` + resize + 定时兜底三层跟踪 |

**无构建步骤**：没有打包器、没有依赖，插件就是几个 ESM / 浏览器脚本文件。

## 已知限制

- 需要一个包含 `dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app` 的 Web profile（DSH 默认的 `web` 模板即是）。
- 会话的**工作区归属仍由工作目录决定**（DSH 架构限制），本插件不改变归属，只额外提供标签维度与归档管理。
- 按钮吸附依赖 DSH 侧边栏的哈希类名 `.hHd-Xa_settingsArea`。DSH 升级若改掉该类名，按钮会自动回退到左下角固定位置，功能不受影响。
- 归档沿用 DSH 的全局归档集合：归档只隐藏、不删除，会话日志仍在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 下。

## 开发

```powershell
node --check lib/index.js       # 宿主插件语法校验
node --check lib/organizer.js   # 客户端脚本语法校验
```

- 改 `lib/organizer.js`：**刷新页面**即生效（脚本每次请求都从磁盘实时读取，无需重启）。
- 改 `lib/index.js`：需要**重启 `dsh web`**（宿主插件只在启动时加载）。

## 发布（Release）

本仓库自带 `.github/workflows/publish.yml`：**推送 `v*` 标签即自动发布到 npm**。

1. 改 `package.json` 的 `version`（例如 `1.0.1`）；
2. commit 并 push 到 `main`；
3. 打标签并推送（标签必须与版本号一致，workflow 会强校验）：

   ```powershell
   git tag v1.0.1
   git push origin v1.0.1
   ```

4. GitHub Actions 会依次执行：语法闸门 → 标签/版本一致性校验 → 同版本重复发布检测 → `npm publish`。

### 认证：Trusted Publishing (OIDC)，无需任何密钥

本包已在 npm 侧配置 **Trusted Publisher**（包页面 → Settings → Publishing access → Trusted Publisher）：

| 字段 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | GitHub Actions |
| Organization or user | `Wang993` |
| Repository | `DSH_OrganizeFilesInTheSameWorkspace` |
| Workflow filename | `publish.yml` |
| Environment name | （留空） |

workflow 在有 `id-token: write` 且**未设置** `NPM_TOKEN` 时自动走 OIDC，因此 CI 里不需要任何长期密钥。
从公开仓库经 OIDC 发布时，npm 还会**自动生成 provenance 证明**（无需 `--provenance` 参数）。

### ⚠️ 已知坑：bypass-2FA token 不能直接发布

npm 自 [2026-07-31](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-31-restricting-npm-bypass-2fa-granular-access-tokens/) 起收紧了两类凭据，配置时务必避开：

- **勾选了 “Bypass 2FA” 的 Granular Access Token**：只能发到**暂存区**（staging），直接 `npm publish` 会报
  `E403 ... E_STAGE_REQUIRED`；CI 里用它会失败。
- 对新包而言，暂存流程还要求包已存在，所以**新包的首次发布必须用「可直达」的方式 bootstrap 一次**：
  本地 `npm login --registry https://registry.npmjs.org` 后发布，或走 `npm stage publish` + `npm stage approve`
  （后者需要维护者用 2FA 审批）。
- 首次发布成功后，后续版本**全部交给 OIDC** 即可；仓库里不要再配 `NPM_TOKEN`，
  否则 workflow 会退回 token 路径从而继续撞上 `E_STAGE_REQUIRED`。

据此，本仓库的推荐配置是：**只保留 Trusted Publisher + 在包设置里勾选
“Require two-factor authentication and disallow tokens”**，不需要任何 token secret。


## 卸载

1. 从 `profiles/web/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `dependencies` 移除本包；
2. 在该目录执行 `pnpm install`；
3. 重启 `dsh web`；
4. （可选）删除 `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-organizer-tags.json`。

## License

MIT

# dsh-live2d-pet

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）界面右下角的 **Live2D 桌面宠物**：用游戏《冷たい目をした黒瀬さん》里提取的
Live2D 模型（kouzhaomei，含 2 张图集），做成可拖拽挂件，点击显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub 装（插件市场收录后同名一条）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qqmqq/dsh-live2d-pet
# 本地开发用链接
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:C:\Users\bai\projects\dsh-live2d-pet"
# 装完必须重启 dsh web 才会加载（插件在宿主启动时挂载）
```

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-live2d-pet`

## 用法

- 出现在右下角（默认 300×380，用**游戏相机取景**裁切，等于游戏里的构图）
- **拖动**移动；松手自动**吸附到最近的左右边缘**；位置/大小/透明度写盘，重启后保持
- **滚轮**缩放（0.5×–2.0×）
- **单击**查看余额（读 `/dsh-live2d-pet/balance.json`；余额来自 `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`，
  key 从 DSH 凭据的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 或同名环境变量取）
- 悬停右上角 **⚙** 菜单：余额 / 大小 ± / 透明度 / 归位 / 隐藏
- 隐藏后右下角留一个 **🐾** 浮标可以叫回来
- 待机动画：呼吸（`ParamBreath`）、眨眼（`ParamEyeLOpen/ROpen`）、轻微摆头（`ParamAngleX/Z`）—— 全部是模型自带参数
- 每 3 分钟自动刷一次余额；接口失败时显示最近一次成功值并标「旧数据」

## 结构

```
package.json          dsh.bundle.patch 声明
cordis.patch.yml      挂载声明(insert id/name)
lib/index.js          宿主插件: 11 条路由 + tapIndex 注入 + 余额缓存/重试/回退
assets/widget.js      页面挂件(原生 JS, 无构建, IIFE 幂等)
assets/lib/           pixi.min.js / live2d.js(Core) / live2dcubismcore.js(框架) / live2d-display.min.js
assets/model/         kouzhaomei.moc3 (4.12 MB) + model3.json + texture_00/01.png
tools/smoke.mjs       独立冒烟测试(假 ctx 起本地 http, 逐条验证路由)
```

## 自测

```bash
node tools/smoke.mjs
# 期望: 11 条路由全 200; state.json PUT/GET 往返一致; tapIndex 注入幂等
```

## 模型来源

从游戏 `Kurose-san_Data\sharedassets*.assets` 的 `CubismMoc` MonoBehaviour 里按字节数组长度切出，
贴图对应关系用运行时 `CubismRenderer.MainTexture` 验证；取景矩形来自运行时相机参数
（canvas 3520×5706 / 可见 2770×3520）。详见 `L2D_Extract/README.txt`。

plugins.description: Temporary side conversations for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Side Chat

独立 DSH 插件，在原生右侧栏打开临时侧聊，复用原生聊天布局。适配 DSH Core `0.2.0-rc.1` 的 Desktop 与 Web 插件接口。

- 输入 `/side`，或点击会话标题栏的“打开侧聊”按钮。
- 输入 `/side 问题`，打开侧聊并直接提问。
- 侧聊使用原生聊天界面，支持流式回复、连续提问、附件、停止、模型和权限设置。
- 打开时聊天区为空。主会话历史只作为后台参考上下文；侧聊界面只显示打开后提交的新问题和回复。
- 主会话继续运行；侧聊独立处理新问题，不自动继续主任务、目标或历史中的工具调用。以打开时已记录的上下文为基底，每次侧聊模型调用都会补入主会话后续消息、工具结果及当前可见流式输出，作为后台参考，不显示到侧聊记录中。
- 同一主会话再次执行 `/side` 会打开已有侧聊。侧聊中不能再创建侧聊。
- 临时侧聊不出现在普通会话列表。关闭标签或收起右侧栏都会停止并清理侧聊；再次打开会创建新的空侧聊。清理尚未结束时，重新打开会等待清理完成。
- 页面离开、App 退出或插件停用会结束侧聊。若进程被强制终止，下一次启用时只清理该版本标记的临时侧聊缓存。
- 遗留临时侧聊若因日志损坏或文件锁定而无法清理，会保留原文件并在日志中记录警告；不阻止插件启用，也不会恢复到新侧聊中。无效的临时标记同样保留，其他有效临时侧聊继续清理。

按 Codex `/side` 的临时会话语义设计：后台继承上下文，可见记录独立，结束时丢弃。底层使用 DSH 原生分支及临时磁盘缓存，关闭时通过原生会话删除接口清理；不保留可恢复归档。继承的目标只在侧聊分支清除，主会话的目标不变。模型和权限沿用 DSH 的原生分支行为。0.1.0 已保存的分支没有新版本的临时标记，升级会保留这些旧记录。

## 安装

在 Desktop 的插件管理中添加 `github:yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat#v0.1.3`，安装并启用。安装后完整退出并重新打开 App，使 Host 和 Client 都加载插件。

网页版安装到 Web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat#v0.1.3'
```

然后重启 Web 进程并刷新页面。也可从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat/releases/tag/v0.1.3) 下载 `dsh-side-chat-0.1.3.tgz`：Desktop 使用插件管理中的本地绝对路径，Web 使用 `dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-side-chat-0.1.3.tgz`。

已验证 DSH Desktop `0.1.39` / Core `0.2.0-rc.1` 的 Desktop 与原生 Web。DSH 仍处于快速迭代阶段，其他 Core 版本尚未验证。

## 开发

使用 Node.js 22.12+ 或 24：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat.git
cd dsh-side-chat
npm ci
npm test
npm run build
```

源码在 `src/`，构建输出在 `dist/package/`。仓库包含构建产物，从 GitHub 安装无需在用户 profile 编译 Client。插件通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 加载 Host，通过 `dsh.client` 与 `./client` 导出加载浏览器模块，React 由 DSH 原生模块表提供。结构参考 [官方 UI 插件说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/preset/agent-preset/skills/cordis-plugin-development/references/ui-plugin.md)。

`npm run test:app` 和 `npm run test:web` 是原生集成检查，需要相邻的 `../dsh-desktop` App 源码目录，且其中已安装 Electron、构建 App 并准备 `.runtime`。检查使用隔离 profile 和本地模拟模型，不访问真实模型服务。`npm run check` 执行全部检查，覆盖空白开启、后台上下文、连续提问、关闭清理、重新创建、页面离开时清理和主会话继续运行。Web 检查启动原生 `dsh --profile web` 网页前端，不注入 Desktop 桥接。

打包可运行 `npm pack ./dist/package --pack-destination /绝对路径/输出目录`。Vite 仅用于开发构建；发行插件没有生产依赖，不包含 App 运行时或其他用户插件。Apache-2.0 许可见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Deterministic prompt-injection interception for DeepSeek Harness — scans what the agent READS before it enters model context; obfuscation-resistant; credential files quarantined on path alone
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-read-guard

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

Deterministic prompt-injection interception for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

**Vendors harden only their own agents at runtime. This plugin is the runtime.**
It hooks dsh's `tools/post-execute` waterfall: every result the watched tools
return — file reads, repo searches, web fetches — is scanned by the
[repo-inject-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/repo-inject-guard) rule
engine **at the moment it would enter model context**, then quarantined,
blocked, or passed. Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

The name states the thesis: it guards what the agent *reads*.

## Why

Repo poisoning and web-content injection enter through what the agent *reads*,
not what the user types. Scanning files at commit time (CI) is too late for a
live session; scanning after the fact is an autopsy. dsh's tool pipeline is the
last choke point before untrusted text reaches the model.

## Competitive landscape (checked 2026-10-12)

The injection-defense lane is a long tail without a winner (~15 plugins, none
above 85★). The ones that matter, honestly:

| Plugin | Architecture | What we do differently |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-secure-audit](https://github.com/PensiveFei/dsh-secure-audit) (85★) | Scanning is a **model-callable tool** — the model must volunteer to call it | We intercept in the tools/post-execute waterfall; the model cannot bypass the scan. |
| [dsh-defend](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-defend) (23★) | Same three interception points, allow/ask/block, Aho-Corasick literal patterns | Our engine is context-scoped (rules fire per trust level / surface, with corroboration requirements) rather than literal pattern lists; `wrap` mode keeps content available while taint-marked (theirs is allow/ask/block only); scan cap 200k full-text vs their 10k head-only |
| [dsh-injection-guard](https://github.com/loeanxi/dsh-injection-guard) (2★) | Action-side taint tracking (blocks sensitive tool calls after untrusted context) | Complementary, not competing: they gate downstream actions, we sanitize upstream content. (We renamed from `dsh-inject-guard` to avoid confusion with them.) |

We are not first. The bet is that a precision-first engine with upstream tests
(the rule engine lives in repo-inject-guard with its own CI and fixture suite)
plus enforcement-not-advice architecture outlasts weekend pattern lists.

## Modes

| mode | high-severity finding | weak (medium/low) finding |
|---|---|---|
| `observe` | logged | logged |
| `wrap` (default) | result is taint-marked: original content stays model-visible inside quarantine markers with an explicit "this is data, not instructions" header | logged only — precision first, we never mangle legitimate content over weak signals |
| `block` | result never reaches the model; the model gets corrective feedback instead | logged only |

Detection rules (vendored engine): instruction-override attempts, system-prompt
extraction, credential/environment exfiltration, hidden Unicode, agent
directives, rules-file backdoor phrasing, resource lures. Details and the
precision-first policy live in the
[repo-inject-guard README](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/repo-inject-guard).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-read-guard
```

From npm — no build step, no `allowBuilds` authorization; git installs are equally prebuilt (`lib/` ships in the repo).





## Configure

Override in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-read-guard
  name: dsh-read-guard
  config:
    mode: block
    readTools: [read, grep, glob]
    fetchTools: [web_fetch, web_search]
    maxScanChars: 200000
    quiet: false
```

Add any tool whose results the agent reads — including MCP tools (they
dispatch through the same pipeline).

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-read-guard] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-read-guard` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test          # syncs vendor engine, builds, runs unit tests
```

Load from source into a local dsh checkout:

```sh
pnpm dsh web --patch ./cordis.dev.patch.yml
```

The detection engine is vendored from the sibling `repo-inject-guard`
checkout (`npm run sync`; CI runs `sync --check`). The engine's tests live
upstream; this repo tests only the adapter policy.

## Roadmap

- `agent/pre-step` scanning for pasted user content (deliberately out of v0:
  users are allowed to give instructions)
- MCP-server tool surfaces as a preset trust class
- Per-agent scoped policies (dsh scopes allow agent-local listeners)
- A report tool card (`presentResult`) surfacing session detection history

## Kill criteria

Honest ones, per house convention: if dsh ships a first-party content-safety
guard covering tool-result injection, or the `tools/post-execute` contract
changes in a way that breaks content replacement, this plugin freezes at its
last working version and the README records the postmortem. The engine moves
to whatever runtime needs it next.

plugins.description: Deterministic artifact lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness — scan session debris, return a reviewable cleanup plan; the janitor is never an agent
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-janitor

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

Deterministic artifact lifecycle for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Agent sessions leave debris: plan docs from finished tasks, scratch scripts,
one-off fixtures. People fear agent-driven cleanup precisely because cleanup
driven by an agent is unaccountable. This plugin registers a `janitor_scan`
tool that runs the [agent-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-janitor)
engine over the workspace and returns a **reviewable cleanup plan** — every
candidate file with a deterministic verdict (protected / keep / recent /
needs-review / safe-to-remove) and the evidence behind it.

**The janitor is never an agent.** The scan and verdicts are pure
deterministic rules (reference analysis, git metadata, age thresholds); v0.1
never deletes anything — applying a reviewed plan stays with the upstream CLI
or with you, on purpose.

Family: read-guard (what agents read) · pr-gate (what they write) · attest
(what they did) · mcp-test (what they can call) · **janitor (what they leave
behind)**.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Nothing in the dsh ecosystem does deterministic workspace hygiene. The
`@goodandready/dsh-time-machine` plugin does checkpoints and rollback
(snapshot safety), which is complementary: it answers "can I undo?", this
answers "what is safe to remove?". Deterministic scan → reviewable plan →
apply as a three-step, non-agent pipeline is unowned.

## Verdicts (fixed order, first match wins)

| verdict | meaning |
|---|---|
| `protected` | exact file or directory prefix in the protected list |
| `keep` | referenced by any code file |
| `recent` | younger than `minAgeDays` (git commit time preferred) |
| `needs-review` | referenced by docs/other, or otherwise ambiguous |
| `safe-to-remove` | plan doc with task merged & zero refs, or zero refs + old enough |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-janitor
```

From npm — no build step, no `allowBuilds` authorization; git installs are equally prebuilt (`lib/` ships in the repo).



## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-janitor
  name: dsh-janitor
  config:
    minAgeDays: 14
    protectedPaths: ["plans", "docs/decisions"]   # exact file or directory prefix
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-janitor] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-janitor` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test   # syncs the vendored agent-janitor engine, builds, runs fixture tests
```

The scan/verdict engine is vendored from the sibling `agent-janitor`
checkout (`npm run sync`; CI runs `sync --check`).

## Roadmap

- `janitor_apply` with an explicit per-path confirmation protocol (still
  deterministic — no agent judgment in the loop)
- Session-debris presets (`.dsh-*` ledgers, scratch plugins dirs)
- Plan archive integration with the upstream CLI's `apply`

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party workspace hygiene, or time-machine-style plugins
add deterministic removal planning, this freezes at its last working version
with a postmortem here. The engine stays owned by agent-janitor either way.

plugins.description: Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images through any OpenAI-compatible image backend
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-imagegen

Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images
through any OpenAI-compatible image backend, so agents can generate images
without per-backend glue. The same tool lists the configured routes, echoes
the declared model lists, and live-probes the backends.

## Tool verbs

| verb        | network | what it does |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `generate`  | yes     | Generates the requested images. The tool writes the image files to disk and runs magic-byte checks on them. |
| `providers` | no      | Lists the configured routes with their fields, the originating layer of each field, and the credential state. The verb reads the local configuration and makes no network request. |
| `models`    | no      | Echoes the declared model list of each route from the config layer. The verb makes no network request; the live model listing is the `status` verb. |
| `status`    | yes     | Probes each route's `GET {baseURL}/models` endpoint and reports reachability plus the live model list. |

Key `generate` behaviors:

- The `prompt` argument is required, and it is the only required argument.
- When the call omits `model`, the tool uses the route's single declared
  model. When a route declares no models, the tool resolves the model by a
  live `/models` probe. When the declared or probed model list contains
  several models, the call fails and lists the candidates.
- The tool sends `size` and `negativePrompt` verbatim, and only when the call
  sets them. The `seed` argument must be an integer, and the tool sends it
  only when the call sets it. The `n` argument is an integer >= 1 with a
  default of 1, and a value greater than 1 requests a batch.
- When the call sets `out`, the output path is that argument (a file path for
  `n = 1`, or a directory marked by a trailing separator or by existing on
  disk). When the call omits `out`, the tool writes the files to
  `<process.cwd()>/images/<unixts>_<i>.<ext>`. The file extension comes from
  the image magic bytes (`png` / `jpg` / `webp`).
- The tool checks the written bytes for PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. When the
  payload is not a recognized image, the call fails with `code: output`, and
  the tool keeps the file on disk. When the path cannot be written, the call
  fails the same way.
- The generate timeout is 180 s by default, and a `timeout` argument of
  1-3600 s overrides it per call. The probe timeout is 10 s.

The plugin ships a `dsh-imagegen` skill. The skill is the full tool reference
for agent contexts: it carries the parameter table, the env contract, and the
error codes.

## Installation

dsh-imagegen is an out-of-tree plugin for a dsh profile. Install it with the
dsh plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-imagegen
```

Configuration is layered: built-in defaults, the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract, a
cordis patch file, a `dsh-imagegen` settings section (see below); the plugin
creates no config or state files.

## Configuration

Providers are configured in any of four layers, lowest to highest priority;
the `providers` verb reports the originating layer of every field, so a
shadowed value is never silent:

1. the built-in default (`api: openai-compatible`),
2. the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract (static per process boot),
3. the cordis config layer (a patch entry with id `dsh-imagegen` and a
   `config` object, or profile-level patches),
4. the `dsh-imagegen:` section in the user settings document
   (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`), which the plugin re-reads on every call, so
   settings edits apply without a restart.

```yaml
dsh-imagegen:
  defaultProvider: local
  providers:
    local:
      baseURL: http://<host>:<port>/v1
    hosted:
      baseURL: https://api.example.com/v1
      apiKeyEnv: IMAGEGEN_HOSTED_KEY
      models: [flux-1]
      displayName: Hosted Images
```

The env contract mirrors the config fields 1:1: `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`,
and per route `<NAME>` the variables `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_BASEURL`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_API`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_APIKEYENV`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_HEADERS`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_MODELS`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_DISPLAYNAME`. The `<NAME>` segment is the route name
uppercased with `-` written as `_`. The `headers` value is a JSON object
string, and the `models` value is a comma-separated list of model ids. The
`baseURL` value is the OpenAI-compatible base URL including the `/v1` prefix
(the same shape as an LLM provider base URL); the plugin appends
`/images/generations` and `/models` to it verbatim, and the image contract has
no server-root endpoints. The `apiKeyEnv` value is a reference to an
environment variable name, never a secret in config; per request the value
resolves from the process environment, then from
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.

## Examples

```jsonc
// Generate with the default route and its single declared model.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "a lighthouse in fog", "size": "1024x1024" }
// Pick a route and model explicitly, and keep the output name deterministic.
{ "verb": "generate", "provider": "hosted", "model": "flux-1",
  "prompt": "an isometric pixel-art garden", "seed": 42, "out": "/tmp/garden.png" }
// Generate a batch into an existing directory.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "three weather variations", "n": 3, "out": "renders/" }
// List what is configured, and where each field comes from.
{ "verb": "providers" }
// List the declared model lists per route (no network).
{ "verb": "models" }
// Probe the backend health (the live /models probe).
{ "verb": "status" }
```

## Troubleshooting

A failing call returns the document `{ ok: false, error: { code, message,
provider?, elapsed_ms } }`. The code set is `invalid_param` / `config` /
`network` / `timeout` / `http` / `protocol` / `output`.

- When a `config` error carries the message "no provider route is
  configured", no route survived configuration. Check the base URLs; the tool
  reports each route that configuration drops as a warning in the log.
- When a `config` error carries the message "credential missing: environment
  variable "X" is not set", the credential reference does not resolve. Set
  `X` in the environment or add it to `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.
- When a `config` error carries the message "unknown provider "x"", the route
  name matches no configured route. Route names match case-insensitively and
  treat `_` and `-` as the same separator; the error lists the configured
  names.
- When a `config` error carries the message "multiple providers configured
  (...) and no default is set", pass the `provider` argument explicitly, or
  set `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, or set the settings `defaultProvider`.
- When an `output` error carries the message "write failed", the tool could
  not write to the `out` path. Check the directory and its permissions.
- When an `output` error carries the message "not a recognized image", the
  backend returned bytes with no PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. Inspect the kept
  file; the backend may return an unsupported container.

## Build

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # tsc -> lib/
pnpm run lint      # eslint src/ test/
pnpm run selftest  # in-process: HTTP stub + config matrix + magic-byte checks
```

plugins.description: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-provider-badge

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

在 DSH Web 输入框的工具行里，紧挨着模型选择器左侧显示**当前会话所用模型的供应商**。

![输入框工具行里的供应商徽标，位于模型选择器左侧](assets/screenshot-1.png)

## 它显示什么

- 供应商名称取自 Host 模型目录里该模型所属的分组名（`ModelProviderGroup.name`），与 `/model`
  弹窗、模型选择器里的分组标题一致。
- 数据源是与模型选择器**同一个** per-session 模型目录（client 服务 `modelDirectories`）：
  还没选过模型的新会话显示部署默认模型的供应商，切换模型后立即跟着变。
- 供应商已从目录移除时，依次退回上一次广告到的失败名，再退回供应商 id 本身。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:huihuangdi/dsh-model-provider-badge
```

装完**刷新一次页面**——客户端半边由 Web 外壳加载，不由 Host 加载。也可以直接指向本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-provider-badge
```

无构建步骤：纯 JavaScript，没有 install / 生命周期脚本，不涉及 `allowBuilds` 授权。

## 位置与实现

- 座位：`conversation.input.right`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 声明），
  在 DOM 中渲染于模型选择器之前——也就是模型名左边的空位。
- `index.js`：Host 半边，一个普通插件行，外加一个只在 profile 有 Web server 时注册的
  只写诊断路由。
- `client.js`：浏览器半边，经 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载，用 `ctx.slots.inject(...)` +
  `ctx.slots.register(...)` 占住座位。
- 样式只用主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-sm`），尺寸对齐宿主模型座位
  （28px 高、13px/400 字号、4px 间距），因此和同一行的控件是一套视觉。
- 文案走 client locale（命名空间 `model-provider-badge`，内置 zh / en）。

## 自检

```sh
node test/activation.selftest.mjs
```

用真实 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 复刻浏览器里的服务拓扑（服务由**兄弟插件**提供，而不是挂在 root 上），
断言插件激活成功、词典与座位注册成功、注入面只带可安全缓存的值。DSH 装在非默认位置时用
`DSH_INSTALL=<@deepseek-ai/dsh 目录>` 指定。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - monotonic guard seam, operator-declared policy, decision ledger. Gate: 12/12 green, 2000 benign FP=0, injected 7/7 caught.
plugins.readme_text:
# @phm-audit/dsh-action-guard

A deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), registered through the official **monotonic guard seam** (`ctx.tools.guard`).

> DeepSeek Harness follows an "everything is a plugin" architecture. This plugin fills one concrete slot: a rules-based, operator-declared guard whose verdicts are reproducible and whose decisions are recorded.

Gate test artifact: 2009-frame deterministic command stream (2000 benign + 7 injected violations + determinism/ledger/pathological-input checks, no RNG, no network) — **0 false positives on benign, all injected violations caught by the intended rule**, 12/12 vitest cases green (2026-10-13). Run: `bash run_demo.sh`.

End-to-end smoke: the Cordis wrapper is additionally verified against the **published npm packages** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-10-13) — loaded the cordis way (`ctx.plugin`, `static inject` resolved), a real tool registered, and a real `execute()` call to a non-allowlisted tool **denied with the expected R-unknown reason through the actual pipeline** (3/3 smoke cases). Version-pinned smoke: the harness is under active development; re-run `npx vitest run tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against your deployed version.

## What it checks (all operator-declared, all deterministic)

- **R-unknown** — tool must be in the declared allowlist
- **R-keys** — forbidden parameter keys per tool
- **R-equals** — denied parameter values per tool
- **R-bounds** — numeric parameter bounds per tool (inclusive)
- **Fail-closed** — an internal evaluation error denies with a distinctive reason (a broken guard can never silently become a hole)
- **Decision ledger** — every verdict appended to a local JSONL ledger with a chain id (correlation artifact for incident forensics; FNV-based chain id, not a tamper-proofing guarantee)

## Method lineage — PHM

This plugin is the harness-native expression of the **PHM deterministic-verification methodology** (gate-first, evidence-first), whose parent project [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) is validated on the **AgentDojo official benchmark with a real LLM in the loop** (no ASR/FP events in the v2.2 re-run, FP fix-cycle 16 → 1 → 0 published, all artifacts open with SHA-256 chains, third-party thread engagement on record).

What that lineage means concretely, versus the (crowded, 155-plugin) Security & Permissions category:

1. **Official third-party benchmark lineage** — the parent method is measured on AgentDojo, not only on self-built samples (verified 2026-10-13 across a 10-repo sample of direct competitors: none cites an industry-standard benchmark; the closest, dsh-defend, uses a self-built 105-sample red-team set).
2. **Cross-domain deployment record** — the same gate criteria (benign FP=0 / injected FN=0 / deterministic repeats / fail-closed / audit ledger) run in robot (Unitree official-URDF gate), traffic-flow (845k-frame NGSIM), and SDK-contract lines — a method with a track record, not a one-off plugin.
3. **Open, recomputable evidence** — every claim in this README has an on-disk artifact: gate counts in `tests/`, smoke in `tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against published npm versions, SHA-256SUMS manifest.

The category being crowded is stated on purpose: this plugin's value is the evidence chain and the standard-interface demonstration, not feature uniqueness.

## Channel facts (from the #9614 review — thanks @argszero)

Four properties of the guard seam that scope what this plugin's ledger and rules can claim, verified against `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` at master (`d743267388`):

1. **The ledger is a guard-layer record, not a complete decision record.** The guard runs only when the pre-execute waterfall returned `allow` (and the user did not refuse an ask, and the call was not cancelled upstream). Denials owned by other layers never enter the guard — a complete audit record needs `tools/pre-execute` + `tools/post-execute` as writers. Our JSONL ledger describes exactly this layer and nothing more.
2. **`R-unknown` is a *name* allowlist, not a *tool* allowlist.** `execution.name` can resolve to different registered definitions across scopes (scope registrations shadow inherited entries). A same-named shadow preset is indistinguishable to the guard.
3. **PTC mode changes the traffic shape.** Model-direct calls of native tool names are denied upstream (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) before the policy pipeline; nested sub-dispatches *do* reach the guard (inheriting `rootCallId`). Policies must therefore cover sub-dispatch argument shapes too, and the allowlist only sees what actually arrives.
4. **Structured denial metadata is channel-forced external.** A guard can only return a string; `denialInfo` in the pipeline comes from the waterfall's decision. The separate JSONL ledger is the channel's requirement, not a stylistic choice — and the refusal reason is model-facing (`Error: <reason>` is the tool result), so keep reasons short and carry the rule id (`action-guard: … (R-bounds)`) to correlate with the ledger.

**Why the guard seam (and not a `tools/pre-execute` listener):** a guard is monotonic — no other layer can force-allow what it denied — while a pre-execute listener sits in a waterfall it does not own, and one early `allow` ends the chain for everyone after it. Deterministic, synchronous, name+arguments policy belongs here; operator-visible asks belong to the waterfall.

**Mount-point note:** all guards are monotonic-deny, so the outcome is order-independent — but the *reported reason* is the first one found (global first, then scope chain farthest-first). If your policy can deny the same call from two layers, pin a single mount point to keep reported rule ids unambiguous.

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

- The policy is **operator-declared** — this is not a general safety oracle, and it does not replace the harness's own permission/sandbox/approval layers; it composes with them at the guard seam.
- Same-source fix cycles are not independent stability trials. The 2009-frame gate is a mechanism demonstration, not a statistical claim.
- The guard core is a pure function (`src/guard-core.ts`, zero dependencies); the Cordis wrapper (`src/index.ts`) imports `ToolGuard` from the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package and is smoke-tested as described above. One earlier revision imported a wrong internal-only package name; the smoke test against npm packages is the guard against that class of error.
- Ledger writes are best-effort and contained; they cannot affect the verdict path.

## Plugin shape (matches harness plugin conventions)

```ts
export const name = 'action-guard'
export const inject = ['tools']
export interface Config { policy: GuardPolicy; ledger?: { path: string } }
export default apply   // registers one ToolGuard via ctx.tools.guard()
```

## License

MIT.

---

**PHM evidence chain** — aggregate ledger: [phm-evidence-ledger](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/phm-evidence-ledger) (5,000,086,001 units, four layers, open metrics + SHA-256 manifest) · method parent: [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) (AgentDojo-validated) · [PHM-Audit profile](https://github.com/PHM-Audit)

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。方向在面板内直接填，回车即开始。
- **横向对比版本**：版本链横着排，每一版一列，内容直接铺开，不用点开就能看到；每一版都跟左边一版做行级对比，新增标绿、删除标红并划掉。
- **等待有反馈**：优化与迭代期间显示进度条和已等待秒数。
- **模板与历史**：五个内置模板（通用优化 / 结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入（载入后自动切回「优化」页）。「存入历史」把结果那一栏当前的内容存成一条手写版本；「存为模板」才是存成可复用的模板。
- **在新对话中使用**：优化结果那一栏可以直接手改；改完点「在新对话中使用」，选一个工作区，插件就会新开一个对话、把这段提示词填进输入框并直接发送，省掉复制粘贴。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代的系统提示词，以及容错清理
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: Model-free local-handoff compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-local-handoff

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**零模型调用**压缩后端：上下文到达阈值后，用本地、确定性、有界的交接文档代替一次额外的模型摘要调用。

> **English:** A model-free compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness. When the context reaches the compaction threshold, it replaces the extra summarization LLM call with a deterministic, bounded handoff assembled locally from the messages being shadowed — no model call, no cost, no added latency, and reproducible output. Everything else about compaction (trigger threshold, verbatim tail retention, tool-result pruning, span selection, locking, `/compact`) is inherited unchanged from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`. Install it with one `dsh plugin add` plus a host restart, and remove the bundle to get the default backend back.

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11（PowerShell） | ✅ | DSH_HOME 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`。npm 会生成 `dsh.cmd` / `dsh.ps1`，本仓库的 preset 查找识别 `PATHEXT`，`npm run dev:link` 使用目录 junction（无需管理员权限）。已在 Windows 11 + Node 24.19.0 上实机跑通全部测试。 |
| macOS（zsh） | ✅ | DSH_HOME 是 `~/.dsh`。npm 全局 `dsh` 通常是指向真实 `lib/bin.js` 的符号链接，preset 查找会先解析它。查找逻辑有 darwin 布局的单元测试，未在真机重复验证。 |
| Linux（bash/zsh） | ✅ | 与 macOS 同一套 Node 代码路径，`dev:link` 用普通目录符号链接。查找逻辑有 linux 布局的单元测试，未在真机重复验证。 |

运行要求：

- **Node.js**：`>=22`（取自 `package.json` 的 `engines`）。
- **DSH peer**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic >=0.2.0-rc.2`（取自 `package.json` 的 `peerDependencies`）。该包由 DSH 自带，必须能从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析到；本仓库不 vendor 它。
- 纯 ESM，**无构建步骤、无新增 npm 依赖**。

## 安装

1. **确认 Node 和 `dsh` 可用**（PowerShell 与 zsh 相同）：

   ```powershell
   node --version
   dsh --version
   ```

   `node` 需要 `v22` 或更高；`dsh --version` 能输出版本号（本机验证时为 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。

2. **安装 bundle**（两个平台逐字相同，不要改写命令）：

   ```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile web add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
   ```

   这条命令把包写进 profile 的 `dependencies`，并把声明了 `dsh.bundle` 的它追加进有序的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表。两者缺一不可：前者让 Node 能找到模块，后者让它作为补丁层参与启动。

3. **重启该 profile 的 host**。新增模块根不在 HMR 热重载范围内：必须完全退出并重新启动运行 `dsh` 的进程（GUI 即重启应用/后台服务）。只刷新页面、只重载配置都不够。

4. 按[验证](#验证)确认它真的在跑本地后端。

**平台差异只有路径**：

- Windows：DSH_HOME 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，profile 目录是 `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web`。
- macOS / Linux：DSH_HOME 是 `~/.dsh`，profile 目录是 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`。
- `dsh plugin …` 本身没有平台差异。

### 手工安装（等价做法）

`dsh plugin add` 只是把 pnpm 和 bundle 选择一起做了。也可以手工两步（手工路径要求 `pnpm` 在 PATH；没有就先 `npm i -g pnpm`，或者直接用 `dsh plugin add`，它会用 DSH 安装自带的 pnpm）：

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web
pnpm add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
```

```zsh
# macOS / Linux
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
```

然后把包名加入该目录 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
] } }
```

### 为什么 `cordis.patch.yml` 是生成出来的

压缩后端在 profile 里被挂了**两层**，只改一层不够：

1. **profile 根**——`dsh-base` 直接挂了一行 `compaction-basic`；没有自己压缩组的 preset（自定义 preset）继承它。当前随 DSH 发布的四个 preset 都有各自的压缩组。
2. **每个 agent preset 内部的隔离压缩组**——`preset-standard` / `preset-ptc` / `preset-minimal` / `preset-cordis` 各自带一个 `cordis:group`，带 `isolate: { compaction: true }`，里面又挂了一份 `compaction-basic`。**正常 GUI 会话跑在 preset 下，用的是这一份。**

第 2 层无法用普通的按 id patch 命中：preset 行的 `config.plugins` 是**数据**，交给 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` 注册后才在 agent 自己的 scope 里挂载，而 loader 的 `applyEntryPatches` 只下钻 `group: true` 的行（preset 行不是）。

registry 的文档给了官方做法——“A new preset or an override of a shipped one is a bundle patch: an `insert` of a `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row, **or a patch keyed by that row's id**”。所以 `cordis.patch.yml` 由 `scripts/sync-presets.mjs` 生成：读**官方发布的 manifest 文件** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`，**逐字复制**，只把那份 `compaction-basic` 换成 `compaction-local-handoff`，其余（persona、plan-mode、delegation……）保持原样。

来源必须是 manifest 文件，**不能**是 `dsh --dump-default-config`：这个 bundle 自己就是一个 bundle，等 dump 渲染出来时它自己的补丁已经生效了——读 dump 等于读本文件的输出，于是 `check:presets` 拿文件和自己比，永远失败（“no preset with a compaction group found”）。一个**永远不可能通过**的漂移守卫比没有更糟，因为它看起来像保护。

代价要说清楚：这意味着这些 preset 清单在你的 profile 里被**冻结**在生成时的那一版。harness 升级若改动了 shipped preset（新增工具、调整 prompt 段），你不会自动拿到。反向也一样：仓库里的快照是在某个具体 harness 版本上生成的（当前为 `0.2.1-rc.2`），比它旧的 harness 可能不认识快照里新增的 preset 行；`peerDependencies` 只保证压缩钩子存在，不保证 preset 行完全一致。源码检出里可以：

```powershell
npm run check:presets     # 只比较，不写文件；过期时非零退出并打印第一处差异
npm run sync:presets      # 重新生成 cordis.patch.yml
```

- `check:presets` 把生成器当前会产出的结果与仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 比较（换行归一化后逐字节比较，不一致时打印第一处差异），不一致就退出 1。
- `sync:presets` 从你安装的 DSH 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml` 重新生成，因此 `check:presets` 比较的其实是“仓库快照 vs 你机器上的 harness”。
- 这两条命令只在**源码检出**里有意义。普通用户经 `dsh plugin add` 安装的是已经打好的包，不需要跑；升级 harness 后如果上游改了 preset，应更新本仓库并重新安装。

生成器对上游 YAML 形状是**硬编码**的（`- insert:` 包装 + 4 空格缩进、`- id: compaction-basic` + `name:` 两行），形状一变就抛错要求更新，不会静默生成错误的东西。

## 它替换了什么

DSH 默认的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` 在上下文到达阈值后：

1. 先用 `tool-result-pruner` 无模型地剪掉超大工具结果（剪完低于阈值就结束）；
2. 仍需压缩时，**发起一次额外的 LLM 调用**（`purpose: "compaction"`）让模型按固定 8 节结构写检查点；
3. 用这条检查点替换最老的一段历史，保留最近约 16% 逐字。

本插件把第 2 步换成纯本地拼装。**第 1、3 步以及全部触发策略保持不变**。思路来自 ComeCode 的本地交接式压缩（`engine/apps/zcode-cli/packages/core/src/compact/local-handoff.ts`），但落在 DSH 官方的扩展点 `summarize()` 上，因此**不需要修改 harness 任何源码**。

| 行为 | 默认后端 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 触发阈值 | `floor(min(W × 0.8, W − O − headroom))` | 同 |
| 逐字保留近期尾部 | `retainRatio 0.16` | 同 |
| 工具结果剪枝 / 图片卸载 | 是 | 同 |
| 区间选择（工具配对安全、不遮蔽系统提示词） | 是 | 同 |
| 日志事务 / 并发锁 / 上下文溢出恢复 / `/compact` | 是 | 同 |
| 检查点怎么来 | **一次模型调用** | **本地拼装，0 次调用** |
| 检查点内容 | 模型自选措辞的 8 节 Markdown | 固定字段、逐字摘录、硬字符预算 |
| 上限 | 模型输出上限 | 6,000 字符，且不超过被遮蔽内容的一半 |
| 成本 / 延迟 | 每次触发都付费，还要等 | 免费、即时、可复现 |

## 交接文档里有什么

`<compacted-summary>` 内是一段有界文本（外层 preamble 由 DSH 自己加）：

- **guide**：不表示任务已完成；最新用户要求（压缩区间内最后一条）；提示完整原文仍在会话日志中、缺失细节按需重读。
- **summary**：阶段性要求/约束（历史内 system 更新，保留来源，标注“不作为新授权”）；压缩区间内涉及的文件（从工具调用参数提取，最多 25 个）；**回合级史书**（装了 [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) 时出现）；最近 4 次工具调用及结果（失败/成功/结果未记录）；最近一条助手进展原文摘录；未解决报错线索（最多 2 条）；上次交接摘录（非新指令）；以及“工具结果只保留预览”的收尾提示。

装了 `dsh-session-recall` 后，交接里会多一段**回合级史书**（≤2400 字符，且不超过交接预算的 40%）：它由会话日志折叠而来，所以**重复压缩也不会丢**——被上一次交接替换掉的早期回合，其结论仍然在里面。没装该 bundle 时行为与之前完全一致；史书读取失败也只会退化成没有这一段，不会让压缩失败。

各字段有独立字符预算（用户要求 1600、进展 900、单条工具 280、约束 300、旧交接 1200），总计硬上限 6,000 字符；实际预算还会被压到“被遮蔽字符数的一半减 600”（600 是给 DSH 固定 wrapper 留的余量）。凭据形态的文本（`sk-…`、`Bearer …`、`api_key=`、`password`/`secret`/`token`）会被 redact，`<thinking>` 块被剥离。

## 验证

### 1. 确认包已安装

PowerShell 与 zsh 相同：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web why dsh-compaction-local-handoff
```

预期输出（版本号以实际安装为准；`0.2.2` 是本源码检出的版本）：

```
dsh-compaction-local-handoff@0.2.2
└── dsh-profile-web (dependencies)

Found 1 version of dsh-compaction-local-handoff
```

注意：这只能证明**装上了**，不能证明 host 已经加载它。见下一步。

### 2. 确认运行时真的走了本地后端

在一个 `agentPreset: "standard"` 的 web 会话里执行 `/compact`，然后看压缩记录/会话日志：

```
17:53:57.134  compaction/start
17:53:57.145  compaction/summary   provider=local  model=local-handoff
              shadowedRange 8-61 · 21 nodes · 5713 tokens
              llmStreamCall=无 · rawOutput=无 · usage=无 · maxTokens=无
```

关键是 `provider=local`、`model=local-handoff`，且摘要事件**不带** `llmStreamCall` / `usage` / `maxTokens`——模型摘要路径一定会带这三者。节点数与 token 数应同界面报告的“已压缩 21 条历史记录（约 5713 tokens）”一致；这条记录 11 毫秒完成。

本仓库还验证过**根路径**：一次性 profile + 小窗口强制触发自动压缩（`compaction (step pressure)`），同样得到 `provider: "local"`、`model: "local-handoff"`，`compaction/start` → `compaction/summary` 间隔 2 毫秒。同时验证到：

- 交接里的“最新用户要求”是**真用户指令**，不是被注入的 `<system-reminder>`（技能目录 / AGENTS.md / 运行时上下文）；
- 反复压缩时上一次交接被当**数据合并**（最多一条 `上次交接携带的文件（可能已过时）`），不会层层嵌套；
- 被遮蔽区间变小时交接跟着变小，能通过后端的“必须比源内容更小”检查。

日志行本身不变：`compaction (step pressure): shadowed N surface nodes ...`。

想在隔离环境里试：`dsh plugin --profile <新 profile> add "<本仓库绝对路径>"`，再用小窗口强制触发自动压缩（做法同本仓库测试）。

### 3. 在源码检出里跑测试

```powershell
npm test
```

裸检出（尚未跑 `npm run dev:link`）会跳过 6 个 engine 测试：

```

ℹ pass 21

ℹ skipped 6
```

```

```powershell
npm run check:presets
```
