plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remote-rea

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）生态插件：**远程连接 + 逆向分析** —— 连上远程主机，定位/拉取目标文件，
调用 REA（及其背后的 Ghidra / Hopper / IDA）做静态分析并回收结构化结果。

**只分析、不利用**：本插件不执行目标、不注入、不改写工件、不做任何利用动作。所有远端命令都先过
提权闸门（见「安全边界」）。

## 三个工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 关键入参 |
|---|---|---|
| `remote_hosts` | 主机库 CRUD：登记别名、认证方式、连通性 `test`、从 `~/.ssh/config` 导入 | `action` + `alias` … |
| `remote_fetch_binary` | 预检（存在 / 大小 / 类型 / sha256）→ 拉取 → 本地复算 sha 比对 → 写 JSON 报告 | `alias`、`remotePath`（绝对路径） |
| `remote_rea_analyze` | 拉取之后探测能力面、选 provider/operation、下发分析子命令、Evidence 落盘并出摘要 | `alias`、`remotePath`、可选 `provider` |

用之前必须先在 `remote_hosts` 里有别名 —— 主机库是这两个分析工具的前置条件，本插件不读任何外部口令。

`remote_rea_analyze` 不指定 `provider` 时自动路由，选路范围是
「REA 广告面 ∩ 已用 `--help` 核对过绑定的子命令」，两者取交集，缺一个就不下发。

## 支持范围

| 层面 | 支持 | 不支持时的行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主 OS | Windows / macOS / Linux | 不可能不支持（`ssh2` 是纯 JS 实现，原生加速模块可选） |
| 宿主 Node | `>=18`（建议 20+） | 由 `package.json` 的 `engines.node` 声明；安装器告警，本插件自身不做版本检查 |
| 远程 OS | POSIX shell（Linux / macOS） | 运行时探测 `uname -s`，命中 `MINGW*`/`MSYS*`/`CYGWIN*`/`Windows*` 直接拒：`不支持的目标平台：Windows 远端，请使用 POSIX shell 目标` |
| 远程 Node | 22.19+ / 24.11+ / 26+（不支持 23 和 25） | 走 npx 前先探 `node --version`，不达标报一句话：`远端 <版本>；REA 要求 Node 22.19+ / 24.11+ / 26+（不支持 23 和 25）`，且**不下发任何 rea 命令** |
| 远程工具 | GNU coreutils，或可降级的子集 | 见下面「预检的降级路径」，每条都有兜底而不是直接失败 |

> 宿主 Node 的 `>=18` 是声明值，未在 18 上实测：本项目的开发/回归环境只有 Windows 侧 node 24.x
> 与 WSL 侧 node 22.22.1。用到的语法（ESM、可选链、空值合并、`node:` 前缀内置模块）都在 18 以内。

### 预检的降级路径

- `stat -c %s` 拿不到大小（BSD/macOS 的 `stat` 不认 `%s`）→ 退回 `wc -c <`；两条都失败 → `sizeBytes=null`。
- `file -b` 失败 → `fileType=null`，路由降级为「按扩展名猜类别」，note 里写明「未经格式头证实」；
  扩展名也认不出来就报 `未知类型：file -b 没有输出、扩展名也认不出来；深度分析需指定 provider`。
- 远端既没有全局 `rea` 也没有 `npx` → `远端无 npx，请安装 Node.js 22.19+ 或全局安装 rea`。
- 符号链接：`file -b` 回的是 `symbolic link to …`，而 `stat -c %s` 给的是链接字符串长度、
  `sha256sum`/SFTP 跟随目标 —— 所以链接目标的 `sizeMatches=null` + `sizeSkippedForSymlink=true`，**sha 才是权威**。

## 已知限制

- **Ghidra 路径已接，未实装验证。** 绑定表见 `rea-provider-router.js` 的 `GHIDRA_BINDINGS`（5 条，
  只有 `--help` 证据、没有任何一次真机跑通），因此**不参与自动选路**，只在调用方显式
  `provider:"ghidra"` 且 REA readiness 判它可用时才走。要实装需自备 **Ghidra 12.1.x** 解包目录并把
  `GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR` 指过去，外加 **JDK 21**（便携 JDK 也行，只要 PATH 上有 `java`）。
- **`analyze-javascript-application` 不在 capabilities 广告面**（providers / capabilities / doctor 三处都没有它），
  作为带标记的**手工例外**接入：`surface='manual-exception'`、`marker='manual-exception:not-advertised'`。
  它的 effects 是空的 —— 也就是「读文件还是写文件系统」REA 自己没说，本项目也不替它猜。
- **`rea-artifact-graph` 只做 inventory，`findings=0` 是结构性的**，不是「这个二进制很干净」：它的 Evidence
  方言里没有 `semantic_graph`，摘要层的 `dialect` 计数会把 `unexplored_branches` / `next_probes` 原样透传，
  深度要靠 Ghidra 那一条路。
- **冷缓存预热可能 50s 到 10 分钟不等**，取决于网络。实测区间 50–83s，但同一条路出现过 120s、420s，
  以及 2026-10-17 在 WSL 上实测的 **534s**（清缓存后用默认预算跑通整链）。`npxTimeoutMs` 因此定为 600000，
  可按调用覆盖。
- **`doctor` 原文不是字节稳定的**：`identity.installations.paths[0]` 会随 npx 缓存位置变化，所以本项目
  不对 doctor 原文做逐字节断言，只按 evidence_id / 字段取用。
- **`@latest` 可能漂移**：`npx --yes rea-agents@latest` 每次解析到的版本可能不同。遇到缓存或行为对不上，
  可把远端命令手动锁成 `rea-agents@<版本>`。
- **`pnpm peers check` 的 missing peer 是静态误报**：DSH profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 设了
  `autoInstallPeers: false`，pnpm 只看 profile 自己的 `package.json`，看不到上层
  `profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`，于是报 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 缺失。
  实测：那两个 peer 由 DSH 运行时自带 —— `profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{cordis,dsh-tools}`
  是指向全局 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 内嵌依赖的符号链接（本机解析到 cordis 4.0.2、dsh-tools 0.1.5-rc.2）。
  插件是从 tarball 解出来的**真实目录**，从它内部 `import.meta.resolve()` 向上走就能命中；
  已装的 dsh-dolphin-security 报的是同一类误报。**只要实际版本落在 peer 范围内，这条警告可以忽略。**

## 跨平台说明

- 开发环境用 **WSL 做真机测试**：Windows → WSL2 的 2222 portproxy 需要管理员权限才能修，本机没修，
  所以 Windows 侧只跑离线套件（逻辑层 + 假 engine），真机套件在 WSL 内部跑。
- `cpu-features` 构建失败**不影响功能**：`ssh2` 把它列为可选加速模块，装不上就退回纯 JS 实现，只是性能略降。
  （这条是 ssh2 上游行为 + 本项目 `loadSsh2`/`isSsh2Available` 的容错设计；我们没有专门实测过构建失败的安装。）
- `REVERSE_HOME` 用**当前 OS 的路径风格**：Windows 上是 `D:\...`，POSIX 上是 `/...`，本项目不做路径翻译。

## 安全边界

- **只分析、不利用**：没有执行目标、注入、patch、改写工件的任何入口。
- **提权硬闸门**：每条远端命令下发前过 `assertNoPrivilegeEscalation`，命中 `sudo` 或
  `--break-system-packages` 直接抛错、不下发（`remote-shell-utils.js`）。探测类命令 `attempts` 固定为 1，
  不做重放 —— 下发前无法确认幂等。
- **`mutates_artifact` 的操作不会被选中**，机制要说准：REA 广告面里确实有带它的组
  （`annotate_native_function`、`set_address_name(s)`、`set_bookmark` / `set_comment` / `set_inline_comment` /
  `unset_bookmark`），但选路的必要条件是「该操作有已核对的 CLI 绑定」，而绑定表里一条写类操作都没有。
  也就是说这是**靠白名单实现的，不是运行期按 effects 拦截**；`effects` 只如实透传进 `route.reason` 给你看。
- **口令不进工具参数**：`authKind=password` 只接受一个环境变量名 `passwordEnv`，口令本体留在宿主进程环境里 ——
  作为参数传会进会话记录。列表/详情回的是脱敏投影（`auth.kind`），不回显口令或私钥内容。

## A 路（Ghidra 深分析）绑定表

| operation | 子命令（`--help` 原文形状） | address |
|---|---|---|
| `analyze_function` | `rea function <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `procedure_pseudo_code` | `rea decompile <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `procedure_assembly` | `rea instructions <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `xrefs` | `rea xrefs <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `read_bytes` | `rea read-bytes <path> <address> [options]` | **必填 → 只登记不下发** |

Ghidra 不可用时，错误信息用的是 REA 自己的原文（`Set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR to an extracted Ghidra 12.1.x
release directory.` ＋ `install_dir / analyze_headless_path / java_command / java_home` 的诊断原值），
本项目不自己编修法。深分析 provider 的 session 是 ephemeral（导入的 Program 与临时工程在 close 时删除），
所以 Evidence 一解析出来就当场落盘。

## 落盘位置

数据根 = `$REVERSE_HOME`（回退 `$DSH_HOME`，再回退 `~/.reverse`）：

- 报告：`<数据根>/reports/fetch-<alias>-<ts>.json`、`analyze-<alias>-<ts>.json`
- 拉取的目标：`<数据根>/targets/<文件名>`
- Evidence：按 `evidence_id` 落盘（`<数据根>/evidence/<evidence_id>.json`），路径写在报告的
  `analysis.evidencePath`；落的是 stdout 里那一行**原始字节**，不重新格式化。

工具返回体里不放远端原始 stdout，也不放全量 Evidence（真机 5.6KB ~ 75KB），只放摘要与路径。

## 安装与挂载

```bash
cd <DSH home> && DSH_HOME=<DSH home> dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-rea
cd <项目根> && DSH_HOME=<DSH home> dsh --profile web --host 127.0.0.1 --no-open
```

`ssh2` / `cpu-features` 需要构建许可：pnpm 11 的门禁会拦依赖的构建脚本
（`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`，退出码 1），要在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里加上

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  cpu-features: true
  ssh2: true
```

装完要重启 `dsh web` 并强制刷新浏览器。桌面端（`desktop` profile）由 Electron 独占管理，
命令行装插件会被拒（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），
入口是应用内的插件管理器。

## 测试

```bash
node test/run-tests.mjs              # 3a 本地解析层
node test/run-probe-tests.mjs        # 3b 远端能力面探测（--offline 只跑逻辑层）
node test/run-deploy-tests.mjs       # 第 4 步 部署链
node test/run-controller-tests.mjs   # 第 5 步 runFetch
node test/run-analyze-tests.mjs      # 第 6 步 runAnalyze（--cold 额外跑破坏性冷缓存）
node test/run-plugin-tests.mjs       # 第 7 步 插件契约 + 跨平台补丁 + A 路
```

需要真机的套件走 `--alias=<别名> --store=<主机库路径>`，别名先用 `remote_hosts` 或主机库脚本登记。

## 许可与第三方声明

本项目以 MIT 发布（`LICENSE`）。`remote-ssh-core.js` 派生自 dsh-web 的 `dsh-ssh`（Apache-2.0），
`remote-shell-utils.js` 派生自 dsh-dolphin-security（MIT，同作者）—— 逐函数的来源位置、修改内容与
许可证原文见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 与 `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/`。

技术债与已知限制的单子在同目录 `TECH_DEBT.md`。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-fallback-queue

**English** | [中文](#中文) --- ## 中文 当前模型限额、限流或不可用时，自动切到队列里的下一个模型，把会话接着跑完。开关、队列、P1 恢复策略都在设置页里点，不需要命令行。 ### 功能 - **请求级自动切换**：命中熔断码立刻熔断当前路由；非即时错误连续失败 2 次也熔断。 - **队列 P1 → Pn**：P1 默认跟随当前会话模型（你在模型选择器里换，P1 跟着换），队列里加的是后备 P2、P3… - **三档 P1 恢复策略**：粘滞（默认）/ 探测回切 / 手动回切。 - **输入框状态芯片**：显示当前生效路由与健康状态，全熔断时是红色「全部熔断」徽章；展开是队列面板，可「切回 P1」或跳到设置页。 - **全熔断降级放行**：所有路由都不可用时按原配置放行，插件不拦截请求。 - **不抢同路由重试的活**：非致命错误一律放行，退避重试仍由 dsh-llm-retry 负责。 - **界面中英双语**：所有界面文案跟随 DSH 的语言设置，自动在中文 / English 之间切换。 ### 效果图 设置页（开关 / 队列 / P1 恢复策略）： ![故障转移设置页：启用开关、P1 → Pn 队列（优先级、路由名、健康徽章、上移/下移/移除）、+ 添加模型、P1 恢复策略三档单选](assets/settings-page.png) 输入框右侧的芯片与展开面板： ![输入框右侧的故障转移芯片与展开面板：P1 当前会话模型、P2/P3/P4 后备路由与健康状态、最近切换记录](assets/chip-panel.png) ### 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-fallback-queue ``` 装完重启 dsh（或刷新 Web GUI），bundle 会随包里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动注册。 ### 用法 1. **设置 → 故障转移** → 打开「启用故障转移」。 2. **+ 添加模型**：挑后备模型（P2、P3…），↑ / ↓ 调顺序，「移除」删掉。 3. **P1 恢复策略**：选粘滞 / 探测回切 / 手动回切。 4. 回到会话：输入框右侧出现芯片，显示当前生效的 P1 路由。 发生切换时，会话里会出现核心自带的「模型已切换」通知，芯片同步切到新路由。 **芯片状态** | 显示 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | `P1` + 绿点 | 正常走 P1 | | `P2`（黄点） | 已切到 P2；黄点表示半开探测中 | | `P!` + 红点 | 队列全部熔断，已降级放行原配置 | | `P`（灰点） | 插件未启用 | **恢复策略三档** | 档位 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | **粘滞**（默认） | 切到 P2 后只要 P2 可用就一直用，P1 恢复也不切回；P2 也挂时按邻近可用往后找，绕回 P1 是最后手段。 | | **探测回切** | P1 冷却到期后，由下一个真实请求探测回 P1；成功留下，失败回 P2（防抖 5 分钟，不发额外探测流量）。 | | **手动回切** | 切走后不自动回 P1，用芯片面板里的「切回 P1」恢复。 | ### 配置项 | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | 设置页可改 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `false` | 总开关 | ✅ | | `queue` | `[]` | 后备队列，数组顺序即优先级（存在 `~/.dsh/fallback-queue-state.json`，不在 settings 里，见下方说明） | ✅ | | `failbackMode` | `sticky` | `sticky` / `probe` / `manual` | ✅ | | `p1Follow` | `true` | P1 跟随当前会话模型 | — | | `immediateCodes` | `QUOTA`、`ACCOUNT_QUOTA`、`RATE_LIMIT`、`AUTH`、`INVALID_CREDENTIAL`、`NO_ADAPTER` | 命中即熔断的错误码 | — | | `failureThreshold` | `2` | 非即时码的连续失败阈值 | — | | `cooldownMs` | `60000` | 熔断冷却毫秒 | — | | `failbackDelayMs` | `300000` | 探测回切防抖毫秒 | — | 日常用的开关、队列、恢复策略都在设置页；标「—」的高级旋钮默认值适用于绝大多数场景，需要时写进 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件那一行的 `config`。 **为什么队列不放在 settings 里**：DSH 的 `ui-theme` 只要你写一次 settings 文档，就会重推一次主题快照，前端随之把整页 design token 逐个移除再写回，深色模式下会闪一帧白。队列排序是高频操作（反复点上下箭头调优先级），放在 settings 里每点一次闪一次；改存独立的 JSON 文件就完全不碰 settings revision，白闪消失。 队列文件是插件私有数据，**不在设置页的配置导出/备份范围内**，换机器需要重新排序。首次升级时如果文件不存在，会自动把 settings 里的旧队列迁移过来，所以已有配置不会丢。 ### 兼容与注意 - 实测 dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2`（宿主 + Web GUI）。 - 兼容范围以 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 为准（当前 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`）。 - 与 `dsh-client-auto-continue` 天然兼容：自动续发走同一条请求瀑布，一样享受队列切换。 - 与 `dsh-llm-retry` 分层：它管同路由退避重试，本插件管跨路由切换。 - 号池类 provider（如 workbuddy-xdpool）单号限流由号池内部换号，整池到顶才轮到本插件跨模型切换。 - 熔断态是内存态，进程重启归零；不写文件、不动 session。 - 队列为空或只有一项时不会发生切换。 - 不要和其他故障转移插件同时启用，两个插件争抢同一错误事件没有意义。 ### 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) --- ## English When your current model hits its quota, gets rate-limited or becomes unavailable, requests automatically fail over to the next model in your queue and the session keeps going. The switch, the queue and the P1 recovery mode are all configured from the Settings UI — no CLI needed. ### Features - **Per-request failover.** Known failure codes trip the current route immediately; two consecutive failures of any other kind also trip it. - **Queue P1 → Pn.** P1 follows the current session model by default (switch models in the picker and P1 follows); entries you add are the backups P2, P3… - **Three P1 recovery modes.** Sticky (default), probe-back, manual. - **Input-box status chip.** Shows the active route and its health, a red “all tripped” badge when nothing is left; expand it for the queue panel with a “Back to P1” action and a settings shortcut. - **Degrades safely.** When every route is tripped the original config is passed through untouched — the plugin never blocks a request. - **Does not fight same-route retries.** Non-fatal errors are always passed through; backoff retries stay with dsh-llm-retry. - **Bilingual UI.** Every label follows the DSH language setting and switches between 中文 and English automatically. ### Screenshots Settings page (switch / queue / P1 recovery mode): ![Failover settings page: enable switch, P1 → Pn queue (priority, route, health badge, move up/down, remove), + Add model, and the three P1 recovery modes](assets/settings-page.png) The chip next to the input box and its expanded panel: ![The chip next to the input box and its expanded panel: P1 is the current session model, P2/P3/P4 are backups with health badges, plus the last-switch line](assets/chip-panel.png) ### Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-fallback-queue ``` Restart dsh (or reload the Web GUI); the bundle registers itself through the `cordis.patch.yml` shipped in the package. ### Usage 1. **Settings → Failover** → turn on “Enable failover”. 2. **+ Add model** to add backups (P2, P3…); reorder with ↑ / ↓, remove with the remove action. 3. Pick a P1 recovery mode. 4. Back in the conversation, the chip next to the input box shows the active P1 route. On every switch the core “model switched” notice appears in the session and the chip follows. **Chip states** | Chip | Meaning | | --- | --- | | `P1` green dot | Running on P1 | | `P2` amber dot | Switched to P2; amber means a half-open probe is in flight | | `P!` red dot | Every route tripped — original config passed through | | `P` grey dot | Plugin disabled | **Recovery modes** | Mode | Behaviour | | --- | --- | | **Sticky** (default) | Once on P2 it stays there while P2 works, even after P1 recovers; if P2 also fails it walks forward and only wraps back to P1 as a last resort. | | **Probe back** | After P1's cooldown expires the next real request probes P1; success keeps it, failure returns to P2 (5-minute debounce, no extra probe traffic). | | **Manual** | Never returns to P1 automatically — use “Back to P1” in the chip panel. | ### Configuration | Field | Default | Description | In Settings UI | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `false` | Master switch | ✅ | | `queue` | `[]` | Backups; # dsh-per-model-temperature

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) 用的**按模型温度**插件：在设置页里给每一条 `llm-pi-ai` 路由的每个模型单独配一个 `temperature`，并在请求真正发出去之前把它塞进去。

一个设置页 + 一个 `agent/request` 监听器，没有别的。

---

## 为什么非得是个插件

DSH 的 provider / model 配置里**没有** `temperature` 这个字段 —— 它能配 `reasoningEfforts`、`contextWindow`、`maxTokens`、`input`、`compat`、`headers`……就是没有温度。

而温度在链路上其实是通的，缺的只是「谁来决定它」：

```
GenerateOptions.temperature
  → LlmCallConfig.temperature
    → pi-ai StreamOptions.temperature
      → dsh-llm-pi-ai 转发进请求体
```

问题出在**生产者**：agent loop 播种请求提案（`seedConfig`）时只带 `provider` / `model` / `reasoningEffort` / `maxTokens`，**没有任何环节会产出 `temperature`**。

唯一的缝是 `agent/request` waterfall —— 而它交给监听器的提案是 **deep-frozen** 的：

```js
const proposedConfig = await this.dispatch.waterfall(
  'agent/request', { turn, step, signal },
  () => Promise.resolve(seedConfig),
)
```

所以监听器不能就地改，必须**返回一个新对象**。本插件做的就是这件事。

---

## 行为

按 **`provider` + `model` 精确匹配**，每次请求重新判定：

| 情况 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 命中，且配了温度 | 注入该温度 |
| 命中，但温度留空 | 移除 `temperature`，走上游默认 |
| 没命中 | 移除 `temperature`，走上游默认 |

第三行是关键：提案会带上**上一个 step 留下的值**。如果只做「命中就注入」，那么一个为模型 A 配的温度会在会话中途切到模型 B 时**跟着过去**；同理，清空配置后旧值也会赖着不走。所以不命中时是主动**清掉**，而不是放着不管。

---

## 安装

> **这个包不在 npm 上，也不打算上。** `package.json` 里是 `"private": true`，
> 分发方式是 clone 仓库 + 本地 `file:` 安装。

**新环境**（首次安装）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/deepmean/dshModeltemperature.git
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:/绝对路径/dshModeltemperature"
```

或者手工两步：

1. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖：
   ```json
   { "dependencies": { "dsh-per-model-temperature": "file:/绝对路径/dshModeltemperature" } }
   ```
2. 把它加进 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组（顺序即加载顺序）。

插件自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，装载时会插入自己的配置行，不用你再写一遍。

### 源码目录与「改完即生效」

本仓库就是**安装源**。怎么让改动生效，取决于当初怎么装的：

| 装法 | 机制 | 之后再改源码 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add file:<源>` | pnpm 把文件**复制**进 `.pnpm` 存储，再在 `node_modules` 建符号链接 | ❌ **不会自动同步**，得重新装一次 |
| `node_modules` 里放**目录联接**指向源目录 | Node 穿透解析到真实路径 | ✅ **立刻生效**，改完刷新页面/重启即可 |

两种都行。想要「改完即生效」，用联接：

```powershell
# 先删掉 pnpm 装出来的那份，再建联接
$nm = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-per-model-temperature"
Remove-Item $nm -Recurse -Force
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $nm -Target "C:\llmProj\modelConfig\dsh-per-model-temperature"
```

或者直接用脚本，它把上面这些连依赖检查、失败回滚一起做了：

```bash
node scripts/relink.mjs
```

**⚠️ 用联接有个前提**：Node 会从**真实路径**（而不是联接路径）往上找依赖，所以源目录**必须自带 `node_modules`**，否则 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 解析不到、插件加载直接失败：

```powershell
cd C:\llmProj\modelConfig\dsh-per-model-temperature
npm install --omit=dev
```

（`node_modules/` 已在 `.gitignore` 里，不会进仓库。）

---

## 更新 dsh 之后（必读）

**每次 `dsh` 更新完，先跑这个：**

```bash
node scripts/check-compat.mjs
```

一条命令查 23 项，覆盖本插件依赖的每一个上游接口。全绿才算好；有红它会直接告诉你该做什么。

### 为什么需要这一步

本插件站在一条**上游并不保证**的缝上：老式 settings API，也就是 `ctx.settings.register()`。

- dsh `0.2.1-alpha.5` 起，上游的 `dsh-settings` 只剩**新式表单模型**（插件自己的 volatile Config），**`register()` 已经不在上游代码里了**；
- 本机是靠 **`dsh-purge` 的 #42 号补丁 `SETTINGS_LEGACY_API`** 把它加回来的 —— 该补丁不仅补回 `register()`，还把 legacy 命名空间接进了 `describe()`（客户端读表单）和 `mutate()`（客户端写表单）。

于是就有了这个失败模式：

```
dsh update  →  覆盖 node_modules 里的文件  →  补丁被冲掉
           →  ctx.settings.register 变成 undefined
           →  插件的 apply() 抛 TypeError
           →  服务端监听器没挂上、设置页没有数据源
           →  表现：插件「失效」，不报错、不崩溃、没日志
```

### 怎么修

1. **重新打补丁** —— `dsh-purge` 的 `purge_apply`（#42 等）；
2. **重启 dsh** —— 补丁改的是磁盘文件，运行中的进程还持有旧模块，必须重启才吃得到；
3. **恢复链接**（用联接方案的话）—— 更新会重跑安装，把链接换成副本：
   ```bash
   node scripts/relink.mjs
   ```
4. `node scripts/check-compat.mjs` 确认全绿。

`check-compat.mjs` 的最后一条专门验这个：**运行中的 dsh 进程启动时间是否晚于补丁写入时间**。补丁打了但没重启，这条会红。

### 为什么链接会被冲掉

profile 用 `file:` 依赖装这个插件，pnpm 的做法是**复制**源目录。于是每次 `dsh update` 都会重跑安装：

```
你把 node_modules 建成指向源目录的联接（想要「改完即生效」）
        ↓
dsh update → pnpm 重新安装 → 联接被真实副本覆盖
        ↓
改动不再同步 —— 而且无声无息，没有任何报错
```

`relink.mjs` 就是干这个的：检测并恢复，幂等、可 dry-run。

```bash
node scripts/relink.mjs            # 检查并在需要时重建
node scripts/relink.mjs --dry-run  # 只看会做什么
```

它会先确认**源目录自带 `node_modules`**（链接生效后 Node 从真实路径找依赖，缺了会加载失败），换链接前把旧目录挪成 `.pmt-copy-backup`，建好后再真 import 一次验证；任一步失败会自动回滚。

---

## 用法

设置页里会多出一节 **per-model-temperature**。每一行三个下拉：

- **提供商** —— 选项来自**活的** `llm-pi-ai` 路由表，不是写死的
- **模型** —— 跟着选中的提供商过滤；选完提供商再换提供商，模型会自动清空（旧模型属于另一条路由）
- **温度** —— 预设 `0 / 0.2 / 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7 / 0.9 / 1 / 1.2 / 1.5 / 2`，加一个「自定义…」

「自定义…」会把那一格变成输入框，**在你填完失焦之后**才落库 —— 所以中途不会写出半截值。留空 = 不下发，交回给上游默认。

存量值不会丢：不在预设里的温度（比如 `0.35`）会照原样渲染成输入框；配置里已经删掉的路由，那一行也仍然可见、可删。

---

## 生效时机（重要）

改了东西要做什么，取决于你改的是哪一层：

| 改什么 | 怎么生效 | 要重启吗 |
|---|---|---|
| 温度值（设置页里改） | **立刻**，下一次请求就读到 | 不用 |
| 温度值（**手工编辑** `settings-legacy.yaml`） | **不生效**，而且会被覆盖 —— 见下 | 不用，但也没用 |
| `client.js`（界面） | 刷新页面 | 不用 |
| `index.js`（服务端逻辑） | 复制进 profile 的副本后重启；或借 HMR 在下一次 profile 重新组合时替换 | 视路径 |

两点说明：

**一、温度只能走设置页改，别去手改那个 yaml。**
`dsh-settings` 的 `ensureLegacyDocument()` 是 `if (this.legacyDocument) return` —— **只在启动时读一次**，之后一直用内存里那份；而 `persistLegacy()` 会把**内存里那份**写回文件。你手改的内容不但读不到，还会在下一次保存时被直接盖掉。

**二、服务端代码不是改完就自动重载的。**
dsh 自带 HMR（`dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `hmr` 行，web 部署下默认启用），但它的 `root: []` 表示**不监听源码目录**。它替换的是「profile 目录下已加载文件在磁盘上发生变化」的插件，触发时机是**下一次 profile 重新组合**（profile manifest、两份用户 patch、或 Plugin Manager 操作）。所以最稳的做法还是：改完 → 复制进 profile 的 `node_modules` 副本 → 重启。

---

## 为什么没有 `top_p` / `top_k`

因为它们**在链路里根本不存在**：`GenerateOptions`、`LlmCallConfig`、两个 adapter 里都没有这两个名字，而且提案在派发前就被 deep-frozen 了 —— 插件没有任何缝可以往里加字段。要做这个，得先改 harness 本身。

同理，本插件**只管温度**：推理档位和输入模态住在 provider 自己的 `llm-pi-ai` 段里，harness 已经有编辑入口；在这里再写一遍会出现两个写同一个键的人。

---

## 测试

六个脚本，都不需要浏览器：

```bash
node scripts/check-compat.mjs             # 23 passed, 0 failed  ← dsh 更新后先跑这个
node scripts/relink.mjs                   # 更新后若变成实体副本，用它接回源目录
node scripts/test-temperature-client.mjs  # 74 通过 / 0 失败
node scripts/probe-apply-temperature.mjs  # 15 passed, 0 failed
node scripts/probe-directory.mjs          # 13 passed, 0 failed
node scripts/probe-live-record.mjs        # 15 passed, 0 failed
```

- **`check-compat.mjs`** —— 兼容性哨兵。逐条验上游接口：`dsh-settings` 的 legacy API 是否在（**本次失效的根因**）、`describe()`/`mutate()` 是否接了 legacy 命名空间、`agent/request` waterfall 是否还在、`temperature` 能否活着穿过 `resolveCallWithInfo` 与 pi-ai 转发层、配置数据是否还在、磁盘副本是否与源码一致、**运行中的 dsh 是否启动于补丁之后**。断了会直接给出该做什么。
- **`test-temperature-client.mjs`** —— 用最小 React 桩把 `client.js` 真跑起来。覆盖「点添加没反应」、「三个字段都是下拉」、「换提供商必须清空模型」、「自定义标记不能串行」、「点菜单滚动条不能把菜单关掉」等曾经真踩过的坑。
- **`probe-apply-temperature.mjs`** —— 把**已安装的那份** `index.js` 当真模块 import 进来，驱动真实的 `apply()` 监听器，验命中/不命中/多行并存/不改写入参。
- **`probe-live-record.mjs`** —— 端到端：用 **harness 自己的 yaml 解析器**读真实的 `settings-legacy.yaml`，过**真实的 `settingsSchema`**，再进真实监听器，证明磁盘上那条记录真的会变成发出去的 `temperature`。
- **`probe-directory.mjs`** —— 验服务端把**活路由表**（`llm.listProviders()`，同步）和**每个路由的模型**（`llm.listModels(route)`，**异步**）发布进设置文档，覆盖「运行时注册的路由也要能选」。含幂等、「某个路由取模型抛错不影响其它」、「宿主不提供 llm 时不抛错」。
- **`relink.mjs`** —— 把 `node_modules` 里那份插件接回源目录。dsh 更新会重跑安装、把链接换成副本，跑它恢复。「改完即生效」靠的就是这个链接。

### 下拉里为什么会有插件自己的路由

`dsh-our-free-model`、`@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin` 这类插件用 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter()` 在**运行时**注册路由，它们**不在** `llm-pi-ai` 的静态 `providers` 段里。设置页的路由来源有三个，按可信度排：

1. **`routes` / `models` 字段** —— 服务端在启动时（以及 `llm/adapters-updated` 时）把活目录写进本插件自己的设置文档。这是主通道：客户端本来就在读这份文档，不依赖 remote API。
2. **remote 目录** —— `llm/listProviders` + `session/modelCatalog`，能拿到就用，拿不到就跳过。
3. **静态 `llm-pi-ai` 段** —— 兜底，只含手写声明的路由。

三个都没有的部署，下拉末尾还有「自定义提供商…」可以手敲 —— 但正常情况下用不到它。

`npm test` 会把四个一起跑。三个探针优先读**已安装副本**（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/...`），读不到才回退到源码目录；可以用 `DSH_HOME` / `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` / `DSH_PACKAGE` 环境变量指到别的部署。

---

## 兼容性

- 对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 声明 `>=0.2.0`（optional peer，缺了也不会拦你装）
- 在 **0.2.1-alpha.4** 上实测通过
- 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 定义设置段

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable permessage-deflate on the WebSocket transport (/api/remote.mux) without modifying the DSH install tree
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ws-deflate

**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Turns on `permessage-deflate` for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) web's WebSocket transport, **without modifying the DSH installation**. Measured on one machine: a session transcript that left the server as **1,206,822 B went out as 350,599 B — 70.9 % fewer wire bytes**.

It is a **runtime monkey-patch, not a supported extension point.** Read "Should I install this" before installing it.

## Should I install this?

**Install it if** you open `dsh web` from somewhere that is not your own machine — a Tailscale/VPN link, a reverse proxy over the internet, any path with real latency or packet loss. DSH replays the whole session transcript over `/api/remote.mux` on every reconnect, so on a lossy link those bytes are paid repeatedly.

**Do not install it if** you only ever use `dsh web` on `localhost` or a LAN. The saving is real but you don't need it there, and what you'd be taking on in exchange is a patch against another project's internals that can go quietly stale on every upgrade.

What it costs, measured on a Windows 10 / node v24 box: **+10 ms** to `dsh` startup (alternating 4-run measurement), and zlib level 6 at **42.7 ms per 1.53 MB** of transcript. The compression is per-message above a 1 KiB threshold, so small events are untouched.

## What it actually changes

Nothing on disk. `ws@8.22.0`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib` were compared file-by-file (sha256) against the pristine registry tarballs: **63 files, 0 mismatches, 0 extra, 0 missing**, and 0 files in the install tree written or created that day.

What it does change is one method, in memory, in the `dsh` process:

```
BEFORE  WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = handleUpgrade(req, socket, head, cb) {   ← ws's own
AFTER   WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = function (req, socket, head, cb) { try {  ← the wrapper
disk sha256 of ws/lib/websocket-server.js: 6d8dd89a841748c8 -> 6d8dd89a841748c8            ← unchanged
```

The wrapper sets `this.options.perMessageDeflate` at **handshake** time, which works because ws 8.x reads that option inside `handleUpgrade` (`websocket-server.js:299`/`:303`), not at construction — so it reaches the gateway's already-built `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` (`dsh-api-gateway/lib/index.js:179`). It only opts in when nothing else set the option, so **if DSH enables compression itself upstream, this plugin steps aside automatically.**

Why the option can't just be configured: DSH exposes no key for it. The webserver's `compression` is HTTP gzip and does not cover streams.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ws-deflate
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The bundle list is read at startup, so no restart means no effect.

## Verify

```bash
grep 'dsh-ws-deflate' <wherever your dsh web logs>
```

You want three things:

```
[dsh-ws-deflate] permessage-deflate enabled -> …/node_modules/ws [ws 8.22.0] via path (level 6, threshold 1024 B, noContextTakeover on)
[dsh-ws-deflate] self test OK: this process negotiates permessage-deflate
[dsh-ws-deflate] negotiated permessage-deflate with Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) …
```

The **self test** is the interesting one. DSH's browser auth rejects non-browser handshakes, so you cannot probe a live server from a script — the plugin instead builds its own `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` on an ephemeral loopback port and does a real handshake against it. That proves *this process, with this ws copy, negotiates*, which is the claim no external probe can reach. The `negotiated …` lines then log the first few real browser handshakes (user agent truncated, `maxLog` caps it at 5, `0` disables).

Browser side, if you want it: DevTools → Network → the `remote.mux` request → Response Headers should contain `Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate; …`.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ws-deflate
```

Restart. Nothing needs restoring, because nothing on disk was ever different.

## Configuration

The entry **registers itself**. The bundle manifest points `dsh.bundle.patch` at the `cordis.patch.yml` shipped inside this package, and DSH inserts the entry while it composes the profile tree — your own `cordis.patch.yml` never has to mention it. Proof, on this machine, from DSH itself:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -B1 -A9 'id: ws-deflate'
# # == dsh-ws-deflate          <- its own layer, named after the bundle
# - id: ws-deflate
#   name: dsh-ws-deflate      <- no config here: the defaults live in the Config schema
```

The entry carries no `config` block by design, so `--dump-config` shows only the id and the name. The values actually in force are printed by the plugin at activation — the same line quoted under Verify: `... (level 6, threshold 1024 B, noContextTakeover on)`. A `0.1.0` install still shows the seven keys in its tree; they were dropped as duplication.

Override it only when you want non-default values, and use a **field-replacing patch, not an insert**:

```yaml
# your profile's cordis.patch.yml
- id: ws-deflate
  name: dsh-ws-deflate      # asserts the existing name; not a rename
  config:
    level: 1
    thresholdBytes: 512
    noContextTakeover: true
    concurrencyLimit: 10
    selfTest: true
    maxLog: 5
```

Two rules, both verified with `--dump-config` rather than taken on faith:

- **`insert` appends; it does not dedupe by id.** Copying the shipped patch into your profile file leaves **two** `- id: ws-deflate` entries in the tree — `level: 6` and `level: 1` both show up — so the override silently does nothing, or runs twice. Measured: entry count goes 1 -> 2.
- **`config` is replaced wholesale, not deep-merged.** Any key you omit falls back to this plugin's schema defaults, not to the bundle patch's values. So list every key you intend to keep.

| key | default | notes |
|---|---:|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the wrapper installed but opts no handshake in |
| `level` | `6` | measured here: level 6 → ratio 0.176, level 1 → 0.238 on the same payload, at 42.7 ms vs 5.9 ms per 1.53 MB |
| `thresholdBytes` | `1024` | below this, frames go out raw (the median DSH event is ~800 B) |
| `noContextTakeover` | `true` | independent deflate stream per frame: bounded memory, and a dropped frame cannot corrupt later messages. Costs ratio, buys robustness on a lossy link — which is the whole reason to run this plugin |
| `concurrencyLimit` | `10` | cap on simultaneous compress operations |
| `selfTest` | `true` | run the loopback handshake at activation. Not hot-reloadable |
| `maxLog` | `5` | how many successful negotiations to log; `0` is silent |

Everything except `selfTest` is `.volatile()`, so editing the patch and letting the profile hot-reload re-applies it without a restart.

## How it finds the gateway's `ws` copy

A plugin cannot `import 'ws'` and get the gateway's copy. The profile is a pnpm tree that contains no `ws` at all; declaring it as a dependency installs a **second** copy — a different class object, and patching it does nothing. Three routes, tried in this order, all tested:

1. **Ask the process.** The gateway's `ws` is in the CommonJS module cache; the class found there is provably the one the gateway uses (`cached === path-required: true`). Match on `ws/lib/websocket-server.js`, **not** `ws/index.js` — ws routes `import` to `wrapper.mjs`, which goes straight at the lib file, so `index.js` never enters the cache in an ESM host. Note `lib/websocket-server.js` does `module.exports = WebSocketServer`, so the export *is* the class.
2. **Guess the path.** Honours `$DSH_HOME` (precedence: configured path > `$DSH_HOME` > `~/.dsh`) and checks `<home>/profiles/node_modules/ws`, which dsh itself creates as a junction into the install tree — the most portable entry. Plus npm-global prefixes for Windows (`%APPDATA%\npm`), Linux (`/usr/local`, `/usr/lib`) and both macOS locations (`/usr/local`, `/opt/homebrew`).
3. **Retry for ~2 s.** If neither finds anything, retry every 250 ms (unref'd, so it can never hold the process open). This is what covers an install whos

plugins.description: A configurable direct channel for the DeepSeek Harness LLM egress: a keep-alive undici Agent with adjustable connect/headers/body/keep-alive timeouts, IPv4-forcing, HTTP/2 off by default, automatic stand-down behind a proxy, and a read-only status route. A minimal patch, one file, zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-undici-timeout

[![awesome · DSH plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

DSH 插件：给 LLM 出口（`globalThis.fetch` → Node 内置 undici）换一条**可配置超时 + 可保活复用**的直连通道。

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)　·　发布流程: [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)　·　收录条目: [`contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/`](contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/)

## 为什么需要它

- Node 内置 `fetch` 背后的 undici，`connectTimeout` 固定 **10s**（DNS+TCP+TLS 全算在内），
  没有环境变量/参数可调；
- 本机（WSL）直连 `opencode.ai` 的新建握手实测出现过 **11.6s**，双栈探测也常整轮
  `AggregateError`（IPv6 无出口 + IPv4 抖动）；
- pi-ai 每次重试都 `new OpenAI(...)` → `Shims.getDefaultFetch()` **当场读全局 fetch**，
  所以每次尝试都是新 TCP+TLS，被 10s 砍掉 → `TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT` → 重试又重连。
  今天（2026-10-13）的日志：87 次 TIMEOUT + 8 次 TRANSPORT，autoswitch 开代理 10 次。

对比：OpenCode（Go 客户端）全程复用一条已建立的 HTTP/2 连接，握手只发生一次，
所以同样的网络下它不超时。本插件就是把这套「长超时 + 保活复用」搬给 DSH。

## 这东西的寿命：它是一个补丁，不是一块功能

它存在的理由只有两条，而且两条都在**上游**，不是 DSH 的既定设计：

1. Node 内置 `fetch` 的 `connectTimeout` 固定 **10s** 且没有开关（Node/undici 上游行为）；
2. undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成 `true`，而 Cloudflare 边缘对 h2 上的 SSE 长流会
   回 `NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM`（上游默认值 × 边缘策略）。

这两条一旦在 DSH 侧被解决 —— 比如 LLM 层允许指定 dispatcher / 连接超时，或者换掉内置
fetch —— 本插件就**没有存在价值了**，直接卸掉：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-undici-timeout   # 或者删掉 profile 里那条 insert
```

判断「可以卸了」的依据（任一条成立即可）：

- 状态路由 `stats` 长期没有 `TIMEOUT`，且直连握手不再接近 10s；
- DSH 的 LLM 层能自己配连接超时 / 强制复用连接（看 release notes，或
  `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 里出现了对应配置项）；
- 上游把内置 fetch 换成了自带 Agent 的实现。

在那之前它是**最小补丁**：单文件、零依赖、只接管白名单域名、随时可摘。
所以只从 GitHub 分发，不发 npm、不进插件市场。

## 原理

```
agent 回合
 └─ dsh-llm-retry（重试）→ dsh-llm-pi-ai → pi-ai → new OpenAI({ fetch: undefined })
      → openai/client.mjs: this.fetch = Shims.getDefaultFetch()   ← 每次尝试当场读全局
      → 【本插件包装过的 globalThis.fetch】
           ├─ 命中 hosts 白名单 且 无代理 env → undici.fetch(url, { dispatcher: 自建 Agent })
           └─ 其它（代理模式 / 非白名单 / Request 输入）→ 原样透传给原来的 fetch
```

- 用**解析到的那份 undici**（`argv[1]` → profile 扫描 → bare）自建 `Agent`：
  `connect.timeout`、`headersTimeout`、`bodyTimeout`、`keepAliveTimeout/MaxTimeout`、
  `pipelining`、可选 `family`。
- **不碰 `setGlobalDispatcher`**：那是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` 的地盘（代理联动靠它），
  抢了会把 net-proxy 弄坏。本插件只接管「本来要走直连」的那部分流量。
- 代理 env（`http_proxy/https_proxy/ALL_PROXY` 任一大写或小写）在场时**自动让路**，
  由 harness 的代理层处理——所以能和 `dsh-net-proxy` / `dsh-net-autoswitch` 共存。

## 配置项（`cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件的 `config:`）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。`false` 时不改 fetch，状态路由仍在。 |
| `hosts` | `["opencode.ai"]` | 命中这些域名（含子域）才接管；`"*"` = 全部直连流量。 |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `30000` | **核心项**。DNS+TCP+TLS 的总预算（内置固定 10s）。范围 1000–600000。 |
| `headersTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 等响应头。 |
| `bodyTimeoutMs` | `0` | 相邻 body 块间隔；`0`=关闭，卡流交给 pi-ai 的 `streamIdleTimeoutMs` 看门狗。 |
| `keepAliveTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 空闲连接保留时长（复用 = 不重握手）。 |
| `keepAliveMaxTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 保活上限。 |
| `pipelining` | `1` | 每连接并发请求数。 |
| `family` | `0` | `0`=跟随系统；`4`/`6`=强制 IP 族（本机 IPv6 无出口时 `4` 很划算）。 |
| `allowH2` | `false` | **⚠️ 见下面「h2 的坑」**。undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成了 `true`，不显式关掉，本插件会顺手把 LLM 出口从 h1 换成 h2。 |
| `autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeoutMs` | `0` | Node happy-eyeballs 的**地址轮换间隔**（默认 250ms）。注意：尝试是**并行保留**的，这个值不是单地址的放弃窗口——黑洞地址实测默认与调大都会等到 connect 超时才死，改大只会拖慢轮换，一般别动。保留它只为极端调优。 |
| `delegateOnProxyEnv` | `true` | 有代理 env 时让路。 |
| `undiciPath` | `""` | 留空自动解析；可显式指到某份 `undici/index.js`。 |
| `probeOnStart` | `true` | 启动时打一次探针（默认打 LLM 网关的 models 端点，不花 token）。 |
| `probeUrl` / `probeTimeoutMs` | `…/zen/go/v1/models` / `15000` | 探针目标与超时。 |
| `logSlowMs` | `0` | >0 时把达到该耗时的请求写日志。 |
| `logFailures` | `true` | 失败请求记日志（含 cause）。 |
| `routePath` | `/_dsh/undici-timeout` | 状态路由。 |
| `logFile` | `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log` | 日志落盘。 |

## 安装

**只从 GitHub 分发**（本插件是上游行为的补丁，不发 npm、不上市场）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout
```

装完**重启 DSH** 生效。也可以钉住某个版本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout#v0.1.1
```

零 npm 依赖、无构建步骤，所以 pnpm 不会弹 `allowBuilds` 授权（本插件没有任何
`prepare` / `install` 脚本）。⚠️ 别和下面路线 B 的 `file://` 直插**同时用**：
包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert id 也是 `undici-timeout`，同 id 冲突。

改完代码想知道「别人 clone 下来到底装不装得上」，本地跑一遍试装验证 —— 把包装进一个
临时 DSH_HOME 里的干净 profile、真启动一次、再请求插件自己的状态路由：

```bash
./scripts/trial-install.sh          # 走 tarball（等价于 GitHub Release 资产）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --git    # 走本地裸仓库 git+file://（等价于 github: 源）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --spec=github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout   # 直接验真实远端
# 🎉 试装验证通过 = 组合成功 + 启动就绪 + 状态路由应答
```

打 tag / 建 Release 的步骤见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)。

### 路线 B：file:// 直插 profile 用户层（改代码时用这条）

`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: undici-timeout
      name: file:///home/mqnu/program/dsh/dsh-undici-timeout/lib/index.js?v=5
      config:
        enabled: true
        hosts: [opencode.ai]
        connectTimeoutMs: 30000
        # 本机 IPv6 无出口：别让地址族探测把预算烧在 10 个死地址上
        family: 4
        # undici 8 的 allowH2 默认是 true，不关掉就会把出口换成 h2（见「h2 的坑」）
        allowH2: false
        bodyTimeoutMs: 0
        keepAliveTimeoutMs: 60000
```

`dsh-hmr` 会监听该文件，**原地写** 2 秒内自动重挂（tmp+rename 会换 inode，收不到事件）。
⚠️ insert 行按 **id 幂等**：只改 `name`（换 `?v=`）或改 `config` 不会立刻重挂——要么**摘掉再插回**，
要么重启 DSH（HMR 的实测行为，和 dsh-net-autoswitch 一致）。
2026-10-15 复验：只把 `?v=4` 改成 `?v=5` 并加配置，HMR 确实重挂了（实例 id、`installedAt`
都换新），但**跑的还是旧模块代码** —— 日志里没有新加的 `h2=off` 字段，状态路由里也读不到
`allowH2`。原因就是同 id 的 entry 按**旧 URL** 重新 import。**摘掉（等 HMR 跑一轮）→ 再插回**，
这次 `?v=5` 才真正被 import，`h2=off` 出现在日志里。改代码务必按这个顺序。

## h2 的坑（2026-10-15 定位，`allowH2` 就是为它加的）

症状：插件明明在跑（`matched` 一直涨），却仍然「很频繁地失败」，重试日志里
`code=TRANSPORT` 暴涨。

根因是一条**静默换协议**：

| | 用的 undici | ALPN 实测 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内置 `fetch`（Node 22 自带） | 6.24.1 | `http/1.1` | h1 |
| 本插件（`argv` 解析到 harness 那份） | 8.11.2 | `h2` | **h2** |

undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值从 `false` 翻成了 `true`
（`lib/core/connect.js`: `allowH2 = allowH2 != null ? allowH2 : true`，
`lib/dispatcher/client.js`: “enabled by default”）。我们用 undici 8 建 Agent，
于是 LLM 出口从 h1 变成了 h2 —— 这不是本插件想要的，却实实在在换了传输层。

代价：`opencode.ai` 前面是 Cloudflare，h2 上的 SSE 长流会被边缘掐：

```
请求失败 CONNECTION（2275ms）…/chat/completions :: ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_ERROR / Stream closed with error code NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
```

- 2026-10-15 当天：插件记了 **85 次失败，其中 79 次是 nghttp2 流错误**（93%），
  全部落在 `/chat/completions`（长流），`/models`（短请求）一次都没有；
- 首次出现 `ERR_HTTP2` 是 **2026-10-14T07:00**，即代理被关掉、插件开始全量接管直连之后；
  重试日志里 `TRANSPORT` 从 ~10/天 → **201/天**（10-14），`TIMEOUT` 则从 238/天 → 4/天
  （**插件治超时的效果是真的**，只是换了个失败形态）。

修法：`allowH2: false`（已进 DEFAULTS）。关掉之后复用一点没少：

| 4 连发（读完 body） | 新建连接数 | 耗时 |
|---|---|---|
| `allowH2: false` | 1 | 924ms → 383 → 363 → 374ms |
| `allowH2: true` | 1 | 947ms → 340 → 350 → 349ms |

即 h1 + `keepAliveTimeout` 的复用与 h2 等价，「不重握手」的目标照旧达成，
而 Cloudflare 那套 h2 流控彻底不参与。

2026-10-15 03:31 热更后（`?v=5`，`family=4` + `allowH2:false`）现场复验：
**75 秒内 22 个请求（全是 `/chat/completions`）20 成功 0 失败，`ERR_HTTP2` 0 次** ——
同一台机器、同一分钟里，改之前是 85 次失败/天、其中 93% 是这个 h2 流错误。

## 直连失败的另一半：20 个地址里的 10 个是死的（2026-10-15 实测）

`opencode.ai` 的 DNS 一次回 **10 个 IPv4 + 10 个 IPv6**，本机 **IPv6 无出口**
（`curl -6` 秒失败）。地址族探测（happy eyeballs）会把预算烧在这 10 个死地址上：

| 同一分钟内的对照 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 裸 TCP 连 10 个 IPv4 | 全部成功，245–1332ms |
| `curl`（双栈）/ `curl -4` | 8/8、5/5 成功，connect 0.27–0.46s |
| **内置 fetch**（undici 6） | **2/6 成功**，4 次 `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`，~2511ms |
| **插件 Agent，family=0** | **6/6 成功**，中位 352ms |
| 插件 Agent，family=4 | 6/6 成功，中位 379ms |

所以「插件生效了吗」的答案是：**生效，而且比内置通道明显强**；
但 `connectTimeoutMs: 30000` 救不了这种形态 —— 整轮在 ~1.0s / ~2.5s 就死掉，
是地址族探测把整轮判死，不是 10s 的 connect 预算不够。`family: 4` 能把这半边也堵上。

WSL 里直连脆弱、本机代理（`127.0.0.1:10808`）实测 3/3 HTTP 200（~0.9s）——
代理开着时插件按设计让路，也就不会被 h2 那套流控碰到。

## 状态/排障

```bash
# 读状态（在机器上直接 curl；Host 白名单只放行回环/本机网卡）
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout | python3 -m json.tool

# 手动补一枪探针
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout \
  -H 'x-dsh-undici-timeout: 1' -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"probeNow"}'
```

- `stats.matched/ok/failed/byError`：接管了多少请求、失败怎么归类；
- `stats.delegatedProxy`：因代理 env 让路了多少（联动在工作就正常）；
- `stats.lastRequests`：最近 10 条（host/path/ms/status/error）；
- `lastProbe`：最近一次探针（启动探针也会写日志）。
- 日志：`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log`。

冒烟（不经过 DSH，验证解析与网络）：

`

plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-codex

Codex 式换窗压缩引擎——彻底替换官方 dsh-compaction-basic 的「LLM 摘要式压缩」。

## 机制

- 继承官方 `BasicCompactionEngine`，只覆写官方承诺的唯一子类钩子 `summarize()`；
- 摘要改为**纯确定性指针模板（零 LLM 调用）**：归档声明 + 恢复通道指引（history_search / history_read / notes read）+ 最近 model 检查点笔记全文（读 `~/.dsh/context-budget/notes/<sid>.jsonl`，只读）+ 被归档区首尾消息截断锚点；
- SummaryResult 走官方契约的模板分支（无 `llmStreamCall` 字段，官方注释点名 "template, remote, or other summarizer"），转录中 `compaction/summary` 事件显示 `provider: template, model: codex-rollover`；
- shadow 事务、replay 定价、工具配对平衡、并发锁、阈值自动触发（0.8×窗口，router-standard 为 0.55）、context-overflow 恢复、/compact（compactNow）全部原样继承。

## 装配

- 源码：`~/.dsh/plugins-src/dsh-compaction-codex/`（本目录），构建：`bash scripts/build.sh`（链接 dsh-install 类型依赖 + tsc 编译 src → lib）；
- profile 链：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-compaction-codex` 软链 + `package.json` link 依赖（防 pnpm install 剪掉）；
- 预设：6 个用户预设（code / code-guarded / code-lean / dshagent / designharness / router-standard）compaction 组中 `compaction-basic` 条目已替换为 `compaction-codex`（2026-09-29，各文件留有 `.bak-20260929` 备份）；
- 生效范围：仅新会话（预设热扫描；运行中会话保持旧代装配）。

## 约束与边缘

- 官方 `summarizeCompaction` 要求摘要帧 token 数 < 被 shadow 内容 token 数；本模板上限约 5K 字符（约 1.5K tokens），对数千 tokens 以上的压缩区安全；极小压缩区会按官方逻辑抛错并留在日志（不会静默）；
- notes 文件缺失/损坏时自动降级（省略检查点段），不阻塞压缩事务；
- 回滚：预设 yml 中把 name 改回 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`（或恢复 .bak）即回官方 LLM 摘要，热生效（新会话）。

## 决策记录

- 2026-09-29 用户拍板：方案 A（子类替换）+ 纯 Codex 式（永不 LLM 摘要，无混合开关）；
- 否决方案 B（从零实现抽象 CompactionEngine：需重写 shadow 持久化/锁/配对平衡，收益零风险高）与方案 C（拆压缩组：长会话必撞上下文硬上限）。

# dsh-superpowers-verified

**A fork of [Superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) for the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)** —
the full Superpowers methodology (brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic
debugging, subagent-driven execution) adapted to run on DSH, installed
**verifiably and reversibly**.

Superpowers is an agentic software-development methodology by
[Jesse Vincent](https://blog.fsck.com) / [Prime Radiant](https://primeradiant.com);
this fork adapts it to DeepSeek Harness. It is not affiliated with or endorsed
by the Superpowers project, Prime Radiant, or DeepSeek.

[![tests](https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

```
15 skills · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) · 86 tests · live-catalog verification · non-destructive install
```

**Keywords:** Superpowers fork for DeepSeek Harness · DSH skills ·
obra/superpowers port · DeepSeek coding agent skills · TDD · subagent-driven
development · agentic workflow for DSH · `superpowers-dsh` alternative ·
DeepSeek Harness 技能包 · 超级技能

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified.git
cd dsh-superpowers-verified
./bin/install.sh --dry-run     # see exactly what will change
./bin/install.sh
```

Then start a fresh DSH session and send `Let's make a react todo list`. A
working install invokes **brainstorming** and asks what you actually want
before writing any code.

**Uninstall reverses it exactly:**

```bash
./bin/install.sh --uninstall
```

## Why this fork exists

Superpowers' skills are mostly harness-neutral, but two things don't carry over
to DSH, and this fork supplies them:

**1. DSH has no session-start hook.** Upstream injects `using-superpowers` via a
`SessionStart` hook (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Muse, Pi, …). DSH's
`dsh-hooks-*` packages *provide* hooks to other harnesses rather than consuming
them. DSH's equivalent channel is its user-global instruction file,
`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, loaded every turn of every session — so the bootstrap
goes there, inside self-managed markers.

**2. DSH has a different tool vocabulary.** Nothing here is named `Agent`,
`Task`, `TodoWrite`, or `Skill`. DSH provides `skill`, `todo_write`,
`subagent`/`subagent_fork`/`workflow`, native plan mode, and a file sandbox.
[`references/dsh-tools.md`](references/dsh-tools.md) is the translation layer.
Upstream's platform-adaptation list is rewritten to name DSH **only**: the
Claude Code reference file left in place describes nested-subagent depth tuning
and a `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` variable that do not exist here.

**3. DSH skill names carry no namespace.** Upstream cross-references its own
skills as `superpowers:writing-plans`, but DSH rejects a colon in a skill name
outright, so those references are unresolvable as written. See
[Known limitations](#known-limitations) — this is the one upstream
incompatibility this fork documents rather than silently patches.

## What makes this fork different

There are several Superpowers ports for DSH. This one is built around two
properties rather than around features:

**Verification against the real catalog, not against prose.** `bin/verify.sh`
mounts DSH's own skill registry and filesystem provider and asks what actually
resolves — then checks it. Around that, `tests/run.sh` is 86 checks covering
snapshot integrity, fidelity against the vendored copy, idempotency, hostile
`AGENTS.md` inputs, migration paths, and uninstall, plus a GitHub Actions matrix
on Ubuntu and macOS. Most ports *assert* DSH compatibility; this one
demonstrates it, and fails loudly when it does not hold.

**An install that cannot damage your setup.** The suite runs entirely in a
throwaway prefix, so it never touches your real skill root or `AGENTS.md`. The
installer owns only the region between its markers, preserves your own
`AGENTS.md` content, appends rather than reorders, and uninstalls exactly what
it installed. Updating means `git pull && ./bin/install.sh` — idempotent, so
running it twice is safe.

**A pinned, auditable snapshot.** The skills are a vendored copy of upstream at
an exact commit ([`vendor/superpowers/README.md`](vendor/superpowers/README.md)),
so installs are offline, reproducible, and diffable against upstream. All
DSH-specific code lives outside `vendor/`.

| | This fork | Typical DSH port |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install mechanism | Filesystem installer into DSH's native skill roots | Cordis plugin bundle via `dsh plugin add` |
| Compatibility evidence | 86-check suite + live-catalog verifier + 2-OS CI | Prose assertion |
| Install reversibility | Marked-block ownership, exact uninstall | Varies |
| Upstream skills | Pinned commit, vendored | Usually synced at build time |

The plugin-bundle approach is more idiomatic to DSH's internals; the
filesystem approach needs no plugin layer and keeps every change reviewable in
your own config. Pick whichever fits how you run DSH.

## What you get

All 15 Superpowers skills:

| Skill | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `using-superpowers` | Entry point: how to find and use skills |
| `brainstorming` | Draw out intent before building |
| `writing-plans` | Break approved designs into bite-sized tasks |
| `executing-plans` | Inline plan execution, one review at the end |
| `subagent-driven-development` | Fresh subagent per task, reviewed |
| `dispatching-parallel-agents` | Fan independent work out in parallel |
| `systematic-debugging` | Root-cause discipline before fixes |
| `test-driven-development` | RED-GREEN-REFACTOR enforcement |
| `verification-before-completion` | Evidence before claims |
| `requesting-code-review` | Pre-merge review |
| `receiving-code-review` | Evaluate feedback on technical merit |
| `finishing-a-development-branch` | Integrate completed work safely |
| `using-git-worktrees` | Isolated workspaces |
| `writing-skills` | Author and test new skills |
| `diagnosing-superpowers` | Post-mortem a session from its transcript |

## Options

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `--target <dir>` | Skill root (default `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` or `~/.agents/skills`) |
| `--dsh-home <dir>` | DSH home holding `AGENTS.md` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`) |
| `--no-skills` / `--no-bootstrap` | Do just one half |
| `--dry-run` | Print intended changes, write nothing |
| `--uninstall` | Reverse the install |

## Verification

Two independent things, both re-runnable:

```bash
tests/run.sh          # 86 checks, offline, no writes outside a temp dir
bin/verify.sh         # audit a LIVE install against DSH's own skill catalog
```

`bin/verify.sh` is the interesting one. It does not read your files and guess —
it mounts DSH's real skill registry and filesystem provider in a bare Cordis
context (the same code the running harness uses), asks for the resolved
catalog, and checks the answers:

```bash
$ ./bin/verify.sh
Verifying Superpowers for DSH
  modules: /Users/you/.npm/_npx/…/node_modules
  skills:  /Users/you/.agents/skills
  AGENTS:  /Users/you/.dsh/AGENTS.md

  ✓ catalog resolves completely        22 skills
  ✓ every vendored skill resolves from --target   15/15 at …/.agents/skills
  ✓ no resolved skill name uses a namespace
  ✓ every installed skill has a loadable name
  ✓ no skill is shadowed by $DSH_HOME/skills
  ✓ DSH reference file installed
  ✓ adaptation list names DSH
  ✓ no other harness is advertised
  ✓ namespace workaround is documented
  ✓ bootstrap present in AGENTS.md     one balanced block
  ! upstream namespace references      46 references use superpowers:<name>; agents must strip the prefix

10 passed, 1 warnings, 0 failed
```

It exits non-zero when something is actually wrong, so it works in CI or a
pre-commit hook. It catches, among others: a skill that is installed but does
not resolve (including one silently skipped by DSH for an illegal name), a
skill shadowed by a higher-precedence root, a platform list that were reverted
to upstream, an unpaired bootstrap marker, and a missing reference file.

Options: `--target`, `--dsh-home`, `--modules <node_modules>`, `--json`. If it

plugins.description: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.readme_text:
# Balance Bucket · 余额水桶

**A little bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent.**

![Six bucket states: full, pouring, low, refilled, unreadable, and dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket/v0.1.1/docs/images/bucket-states.png)

一只挂在窗口角落的小水桶。**水是你的余额，漏出去的是正在花的钱。**

Version 0.1.1.

## What it does

- **The water level is your real balance.** It reads `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` with the same `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` that DSH chats with, so the bucket shows the money you actually have.
- **The water is two layers, because the money is.** Granted balance (赠送) floats on top of topped-up balance (充值). DeepSeek deducts the granted wallet first, so you watch the pale layer empty before the deep one moves.
- **The tap opens while money moves.** The stream and its droplets are proportional to the burn rate over the last three minutes — the tool for watching a `vibe coding` session eat your credit.
- **The bucket is as tall as the highest balance it has ever seen.** It starts full, and a top-up makes it taller rather than overflowing.
- **A failed read never lies.** If the balance cannot be read, the water stays where it was, the tap shuts, and the outline turns amber. It never empties the bucket to show an error.

Move it, resize it, tuck it away — right-click for settings, drag to reposition, arrow keys to nudge.

## Reading the bucket

| Look | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Pale layer on top | Granted balance (spent first) |
| Deep layer below | Topped-up balance |
| Blue water | Above 30% of the highest balance seen |
| Amber water | Between 10% and 30% |
| Red water, gentle wobble | Below 10% |
| Amber outline, no stream | The last read failed; the level is the last known one |
| Grey water, `—` | No API key configured, or the key was rejected |

Hover the bucket for the numbers, or open the settings panel for balance, granted/topped-up split, spent since start, added since start, burn rate, bucket size and the age of the last reading.

## Install

Package page: [dsh-plugin-token-bucket on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-token-bucket).

```text
dsh-plugin-token-bucket
```

Or pin this release:

```text
github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket#v0.1.0
```

The plugin needs the credential DSH already manages for chat. If the Models page has a working DeepSeek API key, the bucket works; if not, it says so instead of guessing.

## Privacy and runtime boundaries

- The API key is resolved through DSH's credential service on every poll and is **never** stored, logged, echoed in an error, or sent to the client half. The browser half never talks to the balance service itself.
- **One** outbound request exists: a read-only `GET` on the documented balance endpoint. No model calls, no telemetry, no listening port, no third-party service.
- Nothing about your conversations is read. This plugin subscribes to **no** session events, so it cannot see prompts, replies or tool output.
- Preferences and history live in the browser's local storage. The plugin never writes your DSH profile.

## Honest limits

- The burn rate is **estimated from balance deltas**, not from token counts: the balance moves in whole cents (¥0.01), so the reading is a rolling three-minute average rather than a per-request figure. It is deliberately not a billing statement.
- Polling is adaptive: every 5 seconds for two minutes after money moves, then 20 seconds, then once a minute while nothing happens. Change calls from other devices or tools are also visible, because they move the same balance.
- Prices, bonuses and the split between granted and topped-up balance are whatever the API reports. The bucket does not compute costs from a price list.
- Balances are read for one currency, preferring CNY.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
npm test
```

`preview/index.html` is a single offline file: open it in a browser, no server and no network needed. Its buttons fabricate balance samples, so every state can be inspected without an API key.

The Host half is bundled to `lib/index.js`, the strict browser/Host contract to `lib/remote.js`, and the browser half to `lib/client.js` by `pnpm run build`. Prebuilt files are committed so a Git install needs no build step.

## License

Code is [MIT](LICENSE). No third-party artwork is bundled: the bucket is drawn with CSS and one inline SVG.

plugins.description: DSH 技能中心：查看、开关、新建、按链接安装、删除（进回收站可恢复）DSH 技能。
plugins.readme_text:
# @suifengshiqu/skill-center

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

**Skill Center** adds one page to the DSH Web client where you can see every skill DSH can load from your own directories, read one, switch it on or off, create one, install one from a link, and delete one into a trash you can restore from.

It is a third-party DSH plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

![The Skill Center panel, open over the composer](docs/shots/list.png)

## Screenshots

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ![The skill list](docs/shots/list.png) | ![Creating a skill](docs/shots/create.png) |
| **The list** — every skill DSH can load, with its switch, its provenance and its problems. The row above it is where a link goes. | **Creating one** — name, description and body, written into whichever destination is selected. |
| ![The trash](docs/shots/trash.png) | ![The delete confirmation](docs/shots/confirm.png) |
| **The trash** — what was deleted, where it came from, and one button to put it back. | **Deleting** — the confirmation says plainly that the skill goes to the trash, because a reversible delete is a different promise from an erase. |

The screenshots are rendered from the shipped browser bundle over the Host's own
`Modal` stylesheet, so the layout, colours and scrollbar are the ones the application
produces; only the surrounding application window is left out. `scripts/dev/render-shots.mjs`
regenerates them, in either theme.

## Where it appears

Two entry points, both opening the same page over one shared store:

- **Settings → Skill Center** — the settings section, so it sits with the rest of the configuration.
- **A `Skills` button in the composer**, in the input row beside the permission chip. It opens the page in a modal, which is the quick path for switching a skill on or off mid-task.

The composer button lives in `conversation.input.left`. That is the only composer seat a plugin may extend: the permission chip (`conversation.input.permission`) and the model picker (`conversation.input.model`) are `single` seats their own plugins already hold, so nothing can be inserted between them. The button also cannot deep-link to its settings section — `openSection` is internal to the settings shell — so it opens the page directly instead.

Both entries follow the Host's theme:

![The same panel in the light theme](docs/shots/list-light.png)

## What it does

- **Lists** the skills under `$DSH_HOME/skills` (default `~/.dsh/skills`), any directory the profile adds through `customSkillDirs`, and the current project's `<project>/.dsh/skills`.
- **Shows details** for one skill: description, path, frontmatter block and instruction body.
- **Searches** by name or description, and can hide the switched-off skills.
- **Switches a skill on or off** without losing it: everything else about the file, including your own frontmatter keys, is left alone.
- **Creates a skill** from a name, a description and a body.
- **Installs a skill from a link** — a GitHub repository, a `/tree/` path inside one, a `.zip`, or a single `SKILL.md`.
- **Deletes a skill into a trash**, and restores it from there.
- **Writes new skills where you choose** — the destination control offers every directory the profile makes available, and the host accepts nothing else.
- **Reports problems** the host would silently skip, such as a missing `description` or a name that is not kebab-case.
- Follows the Host's light or dark theme.

### Where new skills are written

The destinations come from the Host, not from the panel: `GET /roots` answers with the
profile's configured `customSkillDirs` followed by the default `$DSH_HOME/skills`. The
browser offers exactly that list, and `POST /create` and `POST /install` refuse a
directory outside it — so "choose where to write" does not become "write anywhere". With
one destination the control is a sentence; with several, each is a button, because the
path is the point.

### Where deletion is allowed to reach

Removing something the user wrote is the one destructive thing here, so it is bounded:

- **Only DSH's own skills.** The trash covers the global roots (the DSH home and any `customSkillDirs`). A project root — `<project>/.dsh/skills`, which is under version control — is never touched: Skill Center may switch such a skill on or off, but it will not move it out of a repository.
- **Only skills DSH can actually load.** A skill with broken frontmatter may have been misread, which is a reason to leave it alone rather than to move it.
- **Never through a link.** A symbolic link, or a Windows junction (which `lstat` reports as an ordinary directory), is refused by comparing the resolved path with the requested one.
- **Never a plain erase.** The bundle is moved into `~/.dsh/skill-center/trash` with a record of where it came from, and the panel can put it back byte-for-byte. Emptying the trash is a separate, confirmed action.
- **Never a half-move.** Everything is validated before anything moves, and a move that cannot be recorded is rolled back. Because `rename` cannot cross volumes, a failed move falls back to copy-then-remove — copy first, so a failure leaves the original in place.

### What installing a link will and will not do

The download is treated as hostile input: entry paths may not escape the target, a bundle must have a `SKILL.md` with a name DSH accepts and a description DSH requires, an existing name is refused rather than overwritten, and nothing is written until every one of those checks has passed. Private archives and Zip64 are refused. Links to this machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `.local`) are not fetched, and a single download is capped at 8 MB and 800 entries.

### Which layouts are discovered

Matching the Host's own filesystem provider exactly, a skill is a directory bundle `<name>/SKILL.md` or a flat `<name>.md`, **at the top level of a skills root**. Nested `**/SKILL.md` is deliberately not discovered.

This matters when installing from a GitHub download: a repository ZIP extracts to one folder, and copying *that* folder into `~/.dsh/skills` leaves every bundle one level too deep, where neither DSH nor this panel will find it. Move the bundle folders themselves into the skills root.

## What it does not do

- No other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …).
- No Git repositories, no skill marketplace, no automatic updates.
- No creating or importing skills.
- No Trash.
- Nothing outside the two roots above is ever read or written.

## How switching a skill off works

Skill Center writes the two flags the DSH filesystem provider already understands into the skill's own frontmatter:

```yaml
---
name: my-skill
description: What it is for.
disable-model-invocation: true
user-invocable: false
---
```

Switching the skill back on removes exactly those two keys, restoring the document byte-for-byte. Because the flags live in the file:

- the state survives restarts and is visible to any other tool;
- the skill disappears from the model catalogue and the `/` menu, but stays on disk;
- an interrupted write cannot leave a half-written document — the file is replaced atomically.

A skill whose frontmatter cannot be parsed is listed with a diagnosis and its switch is disabled, so Skill Center never rewrites a document it does not understand.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web client (tested against `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

## Install

From npm, which needs nothing on the machine but DSH:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @suifengshiqu/skill-center
```

From source, if you want to change it:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/a766513648-lgtm/dsh-skill-center.git
cd dsh-skill-center
npm install
npm run verify                   # type check, build, tests
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add .
```

Or from a tarball you built yourself:

```powershell
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add .\suifengshiqu-skill-center-0.1.0.tgz
```

Then **restart DSH** — the host half is loaded once at start-up, so a page refresh
alone is not enough — and open **Settings → Skill Center**.

> Installing this package by its git URL doe

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件与设置备份 / 跨机同步工具：一键把全部插件、配置和插件数据打包成可移植 .zip，在新电脑上先预览再批量还原。5 个 agent 工具 + 零依赖独立 CLI；凭据默认排除、可选 AES-256-GCM 加密导出；还原默认只预览，应用前自动生成还原点。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-config-sync

把本机 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**全部插件与设置**备份成一个可移植的 `.zip`，再批量同步到下一台电脑。

> 📖 **日常操作请看 [使用说明.md](使用说明.md)**——按"照着做"的口径编写，含换电脑完整流程、回退步骤和常见问题。本文档偏设计与实现。

## 它解决什么问题

换电脑时，DSH 的环境散落在很多地方：profile 里装了哪些插件、每个插件的版本、`cordis.patch.yml` 里的配置覆盖、插件自己写的数据、全局工作区设置……手工搬极易漏项，而**漏掉一处就可能让新电脑上的 DSH 起不来**。

这个插件把这些收拢成一个文件，并保证还原过程可预览、可回退。

## 核心设计取舍

| 决策 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **不备份 `node_modules`** | 插件本体有几百 MB，且完全可由 `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` 复现。归档只记录版本，还原时重装，新电脑得到的是干净正确的依赖树。 |
| **不备份运行时/Electron/日志/缓存** | 这些属于机器而非用户，是可重建的。把 Windows 运行时拷到新装环境正是"还原把好环境弄坏"的典型原因。 |
| **凭据默认不含，且永不明文** | `.credentials.yaml` 和 `workbuddy-vault/` 里是 API key 和登录 token。归档是会被拷到 U 盘和网盘的文件，**默认排除**；显式要求时用 AES-256-GCM 加密成独立成员。 |
| **还原默认只预览** | 写入前必须先看到"会改哪些文件、会增删哪些插件"。加 `apply: true` 才真正执行。 |
| **应用前自动做还原点** | 每次写入前把当前 profile 配置快照到带时间戳的目录，误操作可退回。 |
| **目标有额外插件时拒绝执行** | 避免"同步一次，把本机独有的插件配置弄丢"。需显式 `overwritePlugins: true`。 |

## 安装

插件目录：`D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync`

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync
```

装完需要**重启 DSH** 才会注册工具。

> 该命令要写 `C:\Users\ThinkPad\.dsh\profiles\desktop`（在工作区之外），在受限沙箱下会报 EPERM，需要一次完全权限。

## 用法

### 在 DSH 会话里（推荐）

装好后直接对 agent 说，例如：

- 「看看我这台电脑现在有哪些插件和设置」→ `dsh_config_status`
- 「把插件和设置备份出来」→ `backup_dsh_config`
- 「把这个备份还原到新电脑」→ `restore_dsh_config`

五个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_config_status` | 看现状：装了哪些插件、各类设置文件数量、备份会包含什么 |
| `backup_dsh_config` | 生成备份归档（支持 `dryRun` 预览） |
| `restore_dsh_config` | 预览/应用还原 |
| `verify_dsh_config` | 校验归档完整性（逐个成员核对 sha256） |
| `list_dsh_backups` | 列出已有归档 |

### 命令行（DSH 起不来时用这个）

```powershell
$cli = "D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"   # 仅用于装插件
node D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync\bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs <命令>
```

```powershell
# 看现状
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs status

# 备份（默认不含凭据和会话）
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 备份并加密包含登录凭据
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip `
     --categories profile-config,home-config,plugin-state,credentials --password 你的口令

# 校验
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 还原：默认只预览
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop

# 确认后真正写入
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

## 换电脑的完整流程

**旧电脑**

```powershell
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\dsh-backup.zip
```

**新电脑**（先装好 DSH 本体）

```powershell
# 1. 校验归档，确认传输没损坏
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\dsh-backup.zip

# 2. 预览：看清楚会写入什么、插件增删情况
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop

# 3. 应用
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

**4. 安装插件**（归档不含 `node_modules`，第 3 步会打印完整命令）

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-pet@0.3.7
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mnemon@0.5.29
# …按第 3 步输出的清单逐个装
```

**5. 重启 DSH。**

## 备份类别

| 类别 | 默认 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `profile-config` | ✅ | `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`cordis.yml`、`cordis.patch.yml` 等 |
| `home-config` | ✅ | `storages/workspace.json`、`telemetry/` 等全局设置 |
| `plugin-state` | ✅ | 各插件在 `DSH_HOME` 下的状态目录 |
| `credentials` | ❌ | 登录凭据，需 `password`，AES-256-GCM 加密 |
| `sessions` | ❌ | 会话记录，体积大 |

## 安全说明

- 明文凭据**从不**进入归档。代码里有一条独立防线：任何成员名命中凭据模式都会直接报错中止，而不是默默写进去。
- `workbuddy-vault/` 存的是明文 token，它在 `plugin-state` 里会被自动排除并给出提示——这是实测发现的真实风险点。
- 加密用 scrypt（N=2¹⁵）派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM，口令错误或归档被篡改都会解密失败，不会还原出似是而非的内容。
- **忘记口令 = 凭据无法恢复**，需要在新电脑重新登录。

## 测试

```powershell
node --test test/          # 或直接：node test/sync.test.mjs
```

覆盖 ZIP 往返与损坏检测、加密往返与错误口令、清单排除规则、凭据隔离、预览不落盘、还原点、篡改检测和 CLI。

> 在受限沙箱里，涉及子进程的 4 个 CLI 用例会因 `spawn EPERM` 跳过——那是沙箱禁止管道 stdio，不是插件缺陷。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-config-sync/
├── bin/dsh-config-sync.mjs   # 独立 CLI（DSH 起不来时的救援通道）
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js              # 插件入口，注册 5 个工具
│   ├── inventory.js          # 决定备份什么（核心策略所在）
│   ├── archive.js            # 备份 / 预览 / 还原 / 校验
│   ├── crypto.js             # 口令加密
│   └── zip.js                # 零依赖 ZIP 读写
├── test/sync.test.mjs
└── cordis.patch.yml
```

零运行时依赖：ZIP 和加密都用 Node 内置模块实现，避免在"正在修环境"的机器上还要先装依赖。

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. Relay and local network are two different setups, not two settings of one, so pick the one that matches wha

plugins.description: Live per-session cost badge for DeepSeek Harness (top-right), with peak/off-peak (time-of-day) pricing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-cost-meter

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2ea44f)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts a **live cost badge in the conversation header (top-right)** and prices every request with **peak / off-peak (time-of-day) tiers**.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Session title                                [¥0.0042]      │   ← badge here
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  … conversation …                                            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Features

- **Live** — the badge updates as the host reports provider usage; no polling, no timers.
- **Historically correct** — each request is priced by its **own wall-clock timestamp**, so a session that spans peak and off-peak stays accurate even if the page sits open overnight.
- **Weekday-aware peak tiers** — DeepSeek bills peak only **Monday–Friday**; weekends are off-peak all day. The schedule is configurable (windows, weekdays, multiplier, time zone).
- **Silent price sync** — a bundled price catalog plus an out-of-band remote catalog refreshed on an interval. Push a new `catalog/prices.json` and every installed copy picks it up **without a plugin release**; a failed refresh keeps the last good rates.
- **Explicit peak/off-peak rates** — models may carry an explicit discounted pair (`cacheMiss` + `cacheMissOffPeak`), not just a multiplier.
- **Route-aware matching** — `provider/model`, `provider/*`, `*`-model wildcards, and case/space/punctuation-insensitive model ids.
- **Never fakes a number** — an unpriced route renders `未配置` (`unpriced`) instead of a made-up fallback rate.

## Install

### From npm (recommended)

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-cost-meter
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` activates it as a profile layer automatically — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

### From a local checkout

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:E:/path/to/dsh-plugin-cost-meter"
```

`link:` keeps the checkout live, so edits apply after a `dsh web` restart without reinstalling.

Restart the server afterwards:

```cmd
dsh web
```

## Configure

The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row with defaults. Override it by adding a `cost-meter` row with the same `id` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: cost-meter
      name: dsh-plugin-cost-meter
      config:
        currency: CNY                 # display currency; empty = catalog currency
        fx:
          cnyPerUsd: 7.1              # used when the catalog is USD and you display CNY
        catalogUrl: ""                # "" = this package's own catalog (derived from repository)
        refreshMinutes: 360           # silent refresh interval; 0 disables it
        pricingTimeoutMs: 4000
        pricingUrl: ""                # optional legacy { models, default } document
        models:                       # manual overrides (highest priority, display currency)
          deepseek-official/deepseek-flash:
            inputPerM: 1.06           # off-peak base
            cacheReadPerM: 0.021
            cacheWritePerM: 1.06
            outputPerM: 4.26
        default:                      # optional fallback; omit to report unknown routes as unpriced
          inputPerM: 1
          outputPerM: 4
        peak:
          enabled: true
          multiplier: 2               # used only when a rate has no explicit off-peak value
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: 480  # UTC+8
          days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]       # ISO weekdays; weekends are off-peak
          windows: [[9, 12], [14, 18]]
```

Two rate styles are accepted everywhere:

- **Catalog style** (peak base + optional off-peak): `cacheMiss`, `cacheHit`, `cacheWrite`, `output`, and `cacheMissOffPeak`, `cacheHitOffPeak`, `cacheWriteOffPeak`, `outputOffPeak`.
- **Legacy style** (off-peak base): `inputPerM`, `cacheReadPerM`, `cacheWritePerM`, `outputPerM` (with optional `*Peak` fields).

## Automatic price updates

Prices resolve in this order (highest wins):

1. `config.models` / `config.default`
2. `config.pricingUrl` (legacy document)
3. the **remote catalog** at `config.catalogUrl` — default: this package's own `catalog/prices.json` on GitHub, derived from `package.json.repository`
4. the **bundled** `catalog/prices.json` (offline fallback)

A timer re-reads the remote catalog and `pricingUrl` every `refreshMinutes` (default 6 hours) and swaps the live table in place:

- a failed refresh **keeps the last successful data**;
- a source that never loaded does not clear anything;
- **historical amounts are frozen**: a sample is priced when it is folded and the amount is stored, so a price change applies only to samples folded after it — a past session's total is never rewritten;
- the frozen amounts ride the persisted projection cache, so they survive restarts; only a cold replay without a checkpoint prices the log at the then-current table.

This makes the catalog the single place to maintain rates: **edit and push `catalog/prices.json`, and installed copies update themselves** — no new plugin release. Forks get their own update channel automatically because the default URL is derived from `package.json.repository`.

To point at a private mirror or a local file, set `catalogUrl` (`https://…`, a path, or `file:///…`). Set it to `""` to disable remote syncing.

## Peak / off-peak

- Tiering uses the **request's own `event.time`**, never "now".
- Peak applies only on the configured weekdays (`days`, default Monday–Friday); weekends are off-peak all day.
- The schedule comes from the catalog's `peakSchedule` (time zone, days, windows, off-peak ratio) and can be overridden field by field in `config.peak`.
- `peak.enabled: false` bills one flat rate; `peak.timezoneOffsetMinutes` shifts the wall clock for the window check.

The hover tooltip shows the current tier, the multiplier, the route, and the token breakdown.

## Pricing model

```
cost = Σ_routes [ cost_off(route) + cost_peak(route) ]

cost_tier(route) = (uncachedInput × miss
                  + cacheRead     × hit
                  + cacheWrite    × write
                  + output        × out) / 1_000_000
```

Totals are accumulated per `{ provider, model }` route and per tier, so switching models mid-session keeps each route on its own price. A repeated usage sample for the same `(turn, step)` replaces the earlier one instead of double-counting.

## Compatibility

| Surface | DSH ≤ 0.1.0-rc.6 | DSH ≥ 0.1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| Projection contract | `schema` + `view` | `stateSchema` + `wire: { viewSchema, view }` |
| Client deps | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` |
| Compatibility gate | — | `engines.dsh` / `peerDependencies` must satisfy the running version |

The badge uses the additive `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot; `…header.corner` is a `single` slot already occupied by a shipped plugin.

## Development

```cmd
npm install
npm test
```

`test/contract.test.mjs` covers the projection contract, weekday peak, catalog parsing, explicit dual rates, currency conversion, normalization/wildcards, unpriced routes, and manual overrides. It runs offline (`catalogUrl: ""`).

## Notes

- Costs are **estimates**: they depend on the provider-reported `usage` and on the price table.
- The badge is **per session**; it does not aggregate sub-sessions or the whole account.
- The bundled catalog is a dated snapshot — verify it against the [official pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) and update `catalog/prices.json` when rates change.
- The plugin is a Web surface plugin; compositions without `sessionProjections` (e.g. headless) skip registration.

## Li

plugins.description: DSH community plugin: ask any set of models to draw a pelican riding a bicycle on a schedule, then lay every drawing out on a read-only board. No scoring — the pictures are the result. Pausable, with a settable interval.
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A DeepSeek Harness **community plugin** that runs a long-term
**model-quality probe** (降智监测) on a schedule, across **any number of
models**:

- **Pick your models** — the gear in the panel's top-right corner lists every model the
  configured providers report (live `/models` discovery, merged with the models
